backend/src/services/payment.service.js
```
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';
import { requestPayment, verifyPayment } from './zarinpal.service.js';
import { activateSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';

const DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS = 30;
const TOMAN_TO_RIAL = 10;
const PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES = Number(process.env.PAYMENT_PENDING_TTL_MINUTES) || 30;

function getCallbackUrl() {
  const base =
    process.env.PAYMENT_CALLBACK_BASE_URL ||
    process.env.APP_BASE_URL ||
    `http://localhost:${process.env.PORT || 3000}`;
  return `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/payments/callback`;
}

function maskCardPan(cardPan) {
  if (!cardPan) return null;
  const digits = String(cardPan).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length < 10) return null;
  return `${digits.slice(0, 6)}******${digits.slice(-4)}`;
}

function toRial(amountToman) {
  return Math.round(Number(amountToman) * TOMAN_TO_RIAL);
}

export function toPublicPayment(payment) {
  if (!payment) return null;
  return {
    id: payment.id,
    planId: payment.planId,
    planName: payment.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: payment.amountToman,
    status: payment.status,
    refId: payment.refId ?? null,
    cardPanMasked: payment.cardPanMasked ?? null,
    createdAt: payment.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: payment.verifiedAt ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * Create a PENDING payment and open a Zarinpal session for it.
 *
 * @param {number} userId
 * @param {{ planId: number, durationDays?: number }} payload
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 * @returns {Promise<{ payment: object, paymentUrl: string, authority: string }>}
 */
export async function createPaymentRequest(userId, payload = {}, req) {
  const planId = Number(payload.planId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(planId) || planId <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
  if (!plan || plan.isActive === false) {
    throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');
  }

  const amountToman = Math.round(Number(plan.price));
  if (!Number.isFinite(amountToman) || amountToman <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const requestedDays = Number(payload.durationDays);
  const durationDays =
    Number.isInteger(requestedDays) && requestedDays > 0
      ? requestedDays
      : Number(plan.duration) > 0
        ? Number(plan.duration)
        : DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS;

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const payment = await prisma.payment.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      planId: plan.id,
      amountToman,
      durationDays,
      status: 'PENDING',
    },
  });

  let gateway;
  try {
    gateway = await requestPayment({
      amount: toRial(amountToman),
      callbackUrl: getCallbackUrl(),
      description: `خرید ${plan.name}`,
      email: user.email,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await prisma.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
      data: { status: 'FAILED' },
    });
    throw error;
  }

  const updated = await prisma.payment.update({
    where: { id: payment.id },
    data: { authority: gateway.authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_CREATED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_CREATED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(updated),
    paymentUrl: gateway.paymentUrl,
    authority: gateway.authority,
  };
}

async function failPayment(payment, reason, req) {
  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count === 0) return false;

  logger.warn(`Payment ${payment.id} marked as FAILED: ${reason}`);

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId: payment.userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_FAILED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return true;
}

async function finalizePayment(payment, verification, req) {
  const outcome = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Atomic compare-and-set: only the first caller can move PENDING -> COMPLETED.
    const claimed = await tx.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
      data: {
        status: 'COMPLETED',
        refId: verification.refId,
        cardPanMasked: maskCardPan(verification.cardPan),
        verifiedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    if (claimed.count === 0) {
      const existing = await tx.payment.findUnique({
        where: { id: payment.id },
        include: { plan: true },
      });
      return { payment: existing, subscription: null, alreadyProcessed: true };
    }

    const subscription = await activateSubscription(tx, {
      userId: payment.userId,
      planId: payment.planId,
      durationDays: payment.durationDays,
    });

    const updated = await tx.payment.update({
      where: { id: payment.id },
      data: { subscriptionId: subscription.id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    return { payment: updated, subscription, alreadyProcessed: false };
  });

  if (!outcome.alreadyProcessed) {
    try {
      await logEvent({
        userId: payment.userId,
        action: 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED',
        entity: 'Payment',
        entityId: payment.id,
        req,
      });
      await createNotification({
        userId: payment.userId,
        type: 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS',
        title: 'پرداخت موفق',
        body: `پرداخت شما با کد پیگیری ${verification.refId} با موفقیت انجام شد.`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Post-payment side effects failed:', error?.message);
    }
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(outcome.payment),
    subscriptionId: outcome.subscription?.id ?? outcome.payment?.subscriptionId ?? null,
    alreadyProcessed: outcome.alreadyProcessed,
  };
}

/**
 * Handle the browser redirect back from Zarinpal.
 *
 * @param {{ authority?: string, status?: string }} params
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 */
export async function handleCallback(params = {}, req) {
  const authority = params.authority || params.Authority;
  const status = params.status || params.Status;

  if (!authority) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'authority الزامی است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
    where: { authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  // Idempotency: a repeated callback for a finalized payment is a no-op.
  if (payment.status === 'COMPLETED') {
    return {
      payment: toPublicPayment(payment),
      subscriptionId: payment.subscriptionId ?? null,
      alreadyProcessed: true,
    };
  }

  if (payment.status === 'FAILED') {
    throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این پرداخت قبلا ناموفق ثبت شده است');
  }

  if (status && String(status).toUpperCase() !== 'OK') {
    await failPayment(payment, `gateway status: ${status}`, req);
    throw new AppError(400, 'PAYMENT_CANCELLED', 'پرداخت توسط کاربر لغو شد');
  }

  let verification;
  try {
    verification = await verifyPayment({
      amount: toRial(payment.amountToman),
      authority,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await failPayment(payment, 'verification failed', req);
    throw error;
  }

  return finalizePayment(payment, verification, req);
}

/**
 * Server-to-server notification endpoint. Zarinpal v4 has no true webhook, so this
 * accepts the same payload shape as the callback and reuses the idempotent path.
 * Never throws: always resolves so the gateway receives a 200.
 */
export async function handleWebhook(payload = {}, req) {
  try {
    const result = await handleCallback(
      {
        authority: payload.authority || payload.Authority,
        status: payload.status || payload.Status || 'OK',
      },
      req
    );
    return { ok: true, ...result };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Payment webhook failed:', error?.message);
    return { ok: false, reason: error?.message ?? 'unknown error' };
  }
}

export async function getPaymentForUser(userId, paymentId) {
  const id = Number(paymentId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پرداخت نامعتبر است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  return toPublicPayment(payment);
}

/**
 * Mark stale PENDING payments as FAILED. Invoked by the 5-minute cron job.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<number>} number of payments expired
 */
export async function expirePendingPayments() {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);

  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { status: 'PENDING', createdAt: { lt: cutoff } },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count > 0) {
    logger.info(`Expired ${result.count} pending payment(s).`);
  }

  return result.count;
}

export default {
  createPaymentRequest,
  handleCallback,
  handleWebhook,
  getPaymentForUser,
  toPublicPayment,
  expirePendingPayments,
};
```

import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';

const DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS = 30;
const TOMAN_TO_RIAL = 10;
const PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES = Number(process.env.PAYMENT_PENDING_TTL_MINUTES) || 30;

function getCallbackUrl() {
  const base =
    process.env.PAYMENT_CALLBACK_BASE_URL ||
    process.env.APP_BASE_URL ||
    `http://localhost:${process.env.PORT || 3000}`;
  return `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/payments/callback`;
}

function maskCardPan(cardPan) {
  if (!cardPan) return null;
  const digits = String(cardPan).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length < 10) return null;
  return `${digits.slice(0, 6)}******${digits.slice(-4)}`;
}

function toRial(amountToman) {
  return Math.round(Number(amountToman) * TOMAN_TO_RIAL);
}

export function toPublicPayment(payment) {
  if (!payment) return null;
  return {
    id: payment.id,
    planId: payment.planId,
    planName: payment.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: payment.amountToman,
    status: payment.status,
    refId: payment.refId ?? null,
    cardPanMasked: payment.cardPanMasked ?? null,
    createdAt: payment.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: payment.verifiedAt ?? null,
  };
}

export async function createPaymentRequest(userId, payload = {}, req) {

  }

  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
  if (!plan || plan.isActive === false) {
    throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');

  const amountToman = Math.round(Number(plan.price));

    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

    Number.isInteger(requestedDays) && requestedDays > 0
      ? requestedDays

        ? Number(plan.duration)
        : DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS;

      planId: plan.id,
      amountToman,
      durationDays,
      status: 'PENDING',
    },
  });

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId: payment.userId,

      entity: 'Payment',

      planId: payment.planId,
      durationDays: payment.durationDays,

    const updated = await tx.payment.update({
      where: { id: payment.id },
      data: { subscriptionId: subscription.id },
      include: { plan: true },

    payment: toPublicPayment(outcome.payment),

export async function handleCallback(params = {}, req) {

  if (payment.status === 'COMPLETED') {
    return {
      payment: toPublicPayment(payment),
      subscriptionId: payment.subscriptionId ?? null,
      alreadyProcessed: true,

  if (payment.status === 'FAILED') {

  if (status && String(status).toUpperCase() !== 'OK') {
    await failPayment(payment, `gateway status: ${status}`, req);
    throw new AppError(400, 'PAYMENT_CANCELLED', 'پرداخت توسط کاربر لغو شد');
  }

  let verification;
  try {
    verification = await verifyPayment({
      amount: toRial(payment.amountToman),
      authority,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await failPayment(payment, 'verification failed', req);
    throw error;
  }

  return finalizePayment(payment, verification, req);
}

  } catch (error) {

```
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';
import { requestPayment, verifyPayment } from './zarinpal.service.js';
import { activateSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';

const DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS = 30;
const TOMAN_TO_RIAL = 10;
const PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES = Number(process.env.PAYMENT_PENDING_TTL_MINUTES) || 30;

function getCallbackUrl() {
  const base =
    process.env.PAYMENT_CALLBACK_BASE_URL ||
    process.env.APP_BASE_URL ||
    `http://localhost:${process.env.PORT || 3000}`;
  return `${base.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api/payments/verify`;
}

function maskCardPan(cardPan) {
  if (!cardPan) return null;
  const digits = String(cardPan).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length < 10) return null;
  return `${digits.slice(0, 6)}******${digits.slice(-4)}`;
}

function toRial(amountToman) {
  return Math.round(Number(amountToman) * TOMAN_TO_RIAL);
}

export function toPublicPayment(payment) {
  if (!payment) return null;
  return {
    id: payment.id,
    planId: payment.planId,
    planName: payment.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: payment.amountToman,
    status: payment.status,
    refId: payment.refId ?? null,
    cardPanMasked: payment.cardPanMasked ?? null,
    createdAt: payment.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: payment.verifiedAt ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * Create a PENDING payment and open a Zarinpal session for it.
 *
 * @param {number} userId
 * @param {{ planId: number, durationDays?: number }} payload
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 * @returns {Promise<{ payment: object, paymentUrl: string, authority: string }>}
 */
export async function createPaymentRequest(userId, payload = {}, req) {
  const planId = Number(payload.planId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(planId) || planId <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
  if (!plan || plan.isActive === false) {
    throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');
  }

  const amountToman = Math.round(Number(plan.price));
  if (!Number.isFinite(amountToman) || amountToman <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const requestedDays = Number(payload.durationDays);
  const durationDays =
    Number.isInteger(requestedDays) && requestedDays > 0
      ? requestedDays
      : Number(plan.duration) > 0
        ? Number(plan.duration)
        : DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS;

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const payment = await prisma.payment.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      planId: plan.id,
      amountToman,
      durationDays,
      status: 'PENDING',
    },
  });

  let gateway;
  try {
    gateway = await requestPayment({
      amount: toRial(amountToman),
      callbackUrl: getCallbackUrl(),
      description: `خرید ${plan.name}`,
      email: user.email,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await prisma.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
      data: { status: 'FAILED' },
    });
    throw error;
  }

  const updated = await prisma.payment.update({
    where: { id: payment.id },
    data: { authority: gateway.authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_CREATED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_CREATED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(updated),
    paymentUrl: gateway.paymentUrl,
    authority: gateway.authority,
  };
}

async function failPayment(payment, reason, req) {
  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count === 0) return false;

  logger.warn(`Payment ${payment.id} marked as FAILED: ${reason}`);

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId: payment.userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_FAILED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return true;
}

async function finalizePayment(payment, verification, req) {
  const outcome = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Atomic compare-and-set: only the first caller can move PENDING -> COMPLETED.
    const claimed = await tx.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
      data: {
        status: 'COMPLETED',
        refId: verification.refId,
        cardPanMasked: maskCardPan(verification.cardPan),
        verifiedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    if (claimed.count === 0) {
      const existing = await tx.payment.findUnique({
        where: { id: payment.id },
        include: { plan: true },
      });
      return { payment: existing, subscription: null, alreadyProcessed: true };
    }

    const subscription = await activateSubscription(tx, {
      userId: payment.userId,
      planId: payment.planId,
      durationDays: payment.durationDays,
    });

    const updated = await tx.payment.update({
      where: { id: payment.id },
      data: { subscriptionId: subscription.id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    return { payment: updated, subscription, alreadyProcessed: false };
  });

  if (!outcome.alreadyProcessed) {
    try {
      await logEvent({
        userId: payment.userId,
        action: 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED',
        entity: 'Payment',
        entityId: payment.id,
        req,
      });
      await createNotification({
        userId: payment.userId,
        type: 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS',
        title: 'پرداخت موفق',
        body: `پرداخت شما با کد پیگیری ${verification.refId} با موفقیت انجام شد.`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Post-payment side effects failed:', error?.message);
    }
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(outcome.payment),
    subscriptionId: outcome.subscription?.id ?? outcome.payment?.subscriptionId ?? null,
    alreadyProcessed: outcome.alreadyProcessed,
  };
}

/**
 * Handle the browser redirect back from Zarinpal.
 *
 * @param {{ authority?: string, status?: string }} params
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 */
export async function handleCallback(params = {}, req) {
  const authority = params.authority || params.Authority;
  const status = params.status || params.Status;

  if (!authority) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'authority الزامی است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
    where: { authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  // Idempotency: a repeated callback for a finalized payment is a no-op.
  if (payment.status === 'COMPLETED') {
    return {
      payment: toPublicPayment(payment),
      subscriptionId: payment.subscriptionId ?? null,
      alreadyProcessed: true,
    };
  }

  if (payment.status === 'FAILED') {
    throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این پرداخت قبلا ناموفق ثبت شده است');
  }

  if (status && String(status).toUpperCase() !== 'OK') {
    await failPayment(payment, `gateway status: ${status}`, req);
    throw new AppError(400, 'PAYMENT_CANCELLED', 'پرداخت توسط کاربر لغو شد');
  }

  let verification;
  try {
    verification = await verifyPayment({
      amount: toRial(payment.amountToman),
      authority,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await failPayment(payment, 'verification failed', req);
    throw error;
  }

  return finalizePayment(payment, verification, req);
}

/**
 * Server-to-server notification endpoint. Zarinpal v4 has no true webhook, so this
 * accepts the same payload shape as the callback and reuses the idempotent path.
 * Never throws: always resolves so the gateway receives a 200.
 */
export async function handleWebhook(payload = {}, req) {
  try {
    const result = await handleCallback(
      {
        authority: payload.authority || payload.Authority,
        status: payload.status || payload.Status || 'OK',
      },
      req
    );
    return { ok: true, ...result };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Payment webhook failed:', error?.message);
    return { ok: false, reason: error?.message ?? 'unknown error' };
  }
}

export async function getPaymentForUser(userId, paymentId) {
  const id = Number(paymentId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پرداخت نامعتبر است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  return toPublicPayment(payment);
}

/**
 * Mark stale PENDING payments as FAILED. Invoked by the 5-minute cron job.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<number>} number of payments expired
 */
export async function expirePendingPayments() {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);

  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { status: 'PENDING', createdAt: { lt: cutoff } },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count > 0) {
    logger.info(`Expired ${result.count} pending payment(s).`);
  }

  return result.count;
}

export default {
  createPaymentRequest,
  handleCallback,
  handleWebhook,
  getPaymentForUser,
  toPublicPayment,
  expirePendingPayments,
};
```

Only `errorHandler.middleware.js` needs to change. `AppError` already stores `this.code`, and `validation.middleware.js` already passes `'VALIDATION_ERROR'` as the code — the handler was simply never reading it. I'm adding `code` to the `AppError` branch, and for consistency I'm also adding a `code` to every other branch (Zod, Prisma, JWT, 500) so clients get a uniform response shape regardless of which path produced the error.

backend/src/middlewares/errorHandler.middleware.js
```
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';
import { PrismaClientKnownRequestError } from '@prisma/client/runtime/library';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

export function notFoundHandler(req, res, next) {
  next(new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Resource not found'));
}

export function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  if (err instanceof AppError) {
    return res.status(err.status).json({
      success: false,
      code: err.code,
      message: err.message,
      meta: err.details,
    });
  }

  if (err instanceof ZodError) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
      message: 'Validation error',
      meta: err.issues,
    });
  }

  if (err instanceof PrismaClientKnownRequestError) {
    if (err.code === 'P2002') {
      return res.status(409).json({
        success: false,
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Duplicate entry',
      });
    }
    if (err.code === 'P2025') {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Record not found',
      });
    }
  }

  if (err instanceof jwt.TokenExpiredError) {
    return res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      code: 'TOKEN_EXPIRED',
      message: 'Token expired',
    });
  }

  if (err instanceof jwt.JsonWebTokenError) {
    return res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
      message: 'Invalid token',
    });
  }

  console.error(err.stack);
  res.status(500).json({
    success: false,
    code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
    message: 'Internal server error',
  });
}
```

Notes:

1. **`meta` is omitted when `details` is undefined.** `JSON.stringify` drops keys whose value is `undefined`, so `AppError` instances constructed without a fourth argument (the common case) produce `{ success, code, message }` with no `meta` key. That's the intended behavior — no `meta: null` noise.

2. **`validation.middleware.js` needs no change.** It already constructs `new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'Validation error', error.issues)`, so the code now flows through to the response as `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'` with the Zod issues under `meta`.

3. **`response.util.js` needs no change.** `AppError` already assigns `this.code`; the success envelope (`ok`/`created`) is unaffected, so success responses keep their current shape.

It follows the conventions of `payment.validator.js` (ES modules, named exports plus a default object) and is written to be used with `validate({ query: ... })` / `validate({ body: ... })`. Since query strings arrive as strings, every numeric/date/boolean field is coerced, and empty query params (`?status=`) are normalized to `undefined` so optional filters don't fail validation.

backend/src/validators/admin.validator.js
```
import { z } from 'zod';

// Query strings arrive as strings, and clients often send `?status=` for an
// unset filter. Normalize blanks to undefined so `.optional()`/`.default()`
// behave as intended instead of failing coercion.
const emptyToUndefined = (value) =>
  value === '' || value === null || value === undefined ? undefined : value;

const booleanish = z.preprocess((value) => {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized === 'true' || normalized === '1') return true;
    if (normalized === 'false' || normalized === '0') return false;
  }
  return value;
}, z.boolean({ invalid_type_error: 'must be a boolean' }));

const roleEnum = z.enum(['ADMIN', 'USER'], {
  errorMap: () => ({ message: 'role must be one of ADMIN, USER' }),
});

const paymentStatusEnum = z.enum(['PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED'], {
  errorMap: () => ({ message: 'status must be one of PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED' }),
});

const sortOrderEnum = z.enum(['asc', 'desc'], {
  errorMap: () => ({ message: 'sortOrder must be asc or desc' }),
});

export const paginationQuerySchema = z.object({
  page: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.coerce
      .number({ invalid_type_error: 'page must be a number' })
      .int('page must be an integer')
      .min(1, 'page must be at least 1')
      .default(1)
  ),
  limit: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.coerce
      .number({ invalid_type_error: 'limit must be a number' })
      .int('limit must be an integer')
      .min(1, 'limit must be at least 1')
      .max(100, 'limit must be at most 100')
      .default(10)
  ),
  sortOrder: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, sortOrderEnum.default('desc')),
});

export const updateUserSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z
    .string({ invalid_type_error: 'fullName must be a string' })
    .trim()
    .min(2, 'fullName must be at least 2 characters')
    .max(120, 'fullName must be at most 120 characters')
    .optional(),
  email: z
    .string({ invalid_type_error: 'email must be a string' })
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .email('email must be a valid email address')
    .optional(),
  phone: z
    .string({ invalid_type_error: 'phone must be a string' })
    .trim()
    .regex(/^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$/, 'phone must be a valid phone number')
    .optional(),
  role: roleEnum.optional(),
  isActive: booleanish.optional(),
});

export const revenueQuerySchema = z
  .object({
    from: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    to: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    groupBy: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z
        .enum(['day', 'week', 'month'], {
          errorMap: () => ({ message: 'groupBy must be one of day, week, month' }),
        })
        .default('day')
    ),
    planId: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'planId must be a number' })
        .int('planId must be an integer')
        .positive('planId must be a positive integer')
        .optional()
    ),
  })
  .refine((data) => !data.from || !data.to || data.from <= data.to, {
    message: 'from must be before or equal to to',
    path: ['from'],
  });

export const paymentFilterSchema = paginationQuerySchema
  .extend({
    status: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, paymentStatusEnum.optional()),
    userId: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'userId must be a number' })
        .int('userId must be an integer')
        .positive('userId must be a positive integer')
        .optional()
    ),
    planId: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'planId must be a number' })
        .int('planId must be an integer')
        .positive('planId must be a positive integer')
        .optional()
    ),
    from: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    to: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    minAmountToman: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'minAmountToman must be a number' })
        .int('minAmountToman must be an integer')
        .min(0, 'minAmountToman must be at least 0')
        .optional()
    ),
    maxAmountToman: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'maxAmountToman must be a number' })
        .int('maxAmountToman must be an integer')
        .min(0, 'maxAmountToman must be at least 0')
        .optional()
    ),
    sortBy: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z
        .enum(['createdAt', 'amountToman', 'status'], {
          errorMap: () => ({ message: 'sortBy must be one of createdAt, amountToman, status' }),
        })
        .default('createdAt')
    ),
  })
  .refine((data) => !data.from || !data.to || data.from <= data.to, {
    message: 'from must be before or equal to to',
    path: ['from'],
  })
  .refine(
    (data) =>
      data.minAmountToman === undefined ||
      data.maxAmountToman === undefined ||
      data.minAmountToman <= data.maxAmountToman,
    { message: 'minAmountToman must be less than or equal to maxAmountToman', path: ['minAmountToman'] }
  );

export default {
  paginationQuerySchema,
  updateUserSchema,
  revenueQuerySchema,
  paymentFilterSchema,
};
```

```js
  totalUsers,
  activeUsers,
  newUsersLast30Days,
  totalPayments,
  completedPayments,

  totalPlans,

]);

};
```

```js
export async function listUsers({ page = 1, limit = 10, sortOrder = 'desc' } = {}) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  const [users, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.user.findMany({
      orderBy: { createdAt: sortOrder },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      select: {
        id: true, email: true, fullName: true, role: true, isActive: true,
        lastLoginAt: true, createdAt: true, updatedAt: true,
      },
    }),
    prisma.user.count(),
  ]);
  return { data: users, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}
```

```js
  const id = Number(userId);

      include: { plan: true },

    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where: { userId: id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },

    prisma.auditLog.findMany({
      where: { userId: id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 20,
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    user,
    subscription: subscription ? toPublicSubscription(subscription) : null,
    recentPayments: payments.map(toPublicPayment),

  };
}
```

```js
}
```

`listPayments`:

```js
export async function listPayments(filters = {}) {
  const { page = 1, limit = 10, sortOrder = 'desc', sortBy = 'createdAt', status, userId, planId, from, to, minAmountToman, maxAmountToman } = filters;
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const where = {};
  if (status) where.status = status;
  if (userId) where.userId = userId;
  if (planId) where.planId = planId;
  if (from || to) {
    where.createdAt = {};
    if (from) where.createdAt.gte = from;
    if (to) where.createdAt.lte = to;
  }
  if (minAmountToman !== undefined || maxAmountToman !== undefined) {
    where.amountToman = {};
    if (minAmountToman !== undefined) where.amountToman.gte = minAmountToman;
    if (maxAmountToman !== undefined) where.amountToman.lte = maxAmountToman;
  }

  const [payments, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { [sortBy]: sortOrder },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      include: { plan: true, user: { select: { id: true, email: true, fullName: true } } },
    }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where }),
  ]);

  return {
    data: payments.map((p) => ({
      ...toPublicPayment(p),
      user: p.user,
    })),
    meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) },
  };
}
```

```js
export async function createPlan(data) {
  const name = String(data.name || '').trim();
  if (!name) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'نام پلن الزامی است');

  const price = Number(data.price);
  if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');

  const duration = Number(data.duration);
  if (!Number.isInteger(duration) || duration <= 0) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'مدت پلن نامعتبر است');

  const plan = await prisma.plan.create({
    data: {
      name,
      description: data.description ?? null,
      price,
      duration,
      isActive: data.isActive !== undefined ? Boolean(data.isActive) : true,
    },
  });

  await logEvent({ action: 'ADMIN_PLAN_CREATED', entity: 'Plan', entityId: plan.id });
  return plan;
}
```

`updatePlan`:

```js
export async function updatePlan(planId, data) {
  const id = Number(planId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پلن نامعتبر است');

  const existing = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');

  const updateData = {};
  if (data.name !== undefined) {
    const name = String(data.name).trim();
    if (!name) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'نام پلن نامعتبر است');
    updateData.name = name;
  }
  if (data.description !== undefined) updateData.description = data.description;
  if (data.price !== undefined) {
    const price = Number(data.price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
    updateData.price = price;
  }
  if (data.duration !== undefined) {
    const duration = Number(data.duration);
    if (!Number.isInteger(duration) || duration <= 0) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'مدت پلن نامعتبر است');
    updateData.duration = duration;
  }
  if (data.isActive !== undefined) updateData.isActive = Boolean(data.isActive);

  if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'هیچ فیلدی برای به‌روزرسانی ارسال نشده است');
  }

  const updated = await prisma.plan.update({ where: { id }, data: updateData });
  await logEvent({ action: 'ADMIN_PLAN_UPDATED', entity: 'Plan', entityId: id, details: { fields: Object.keys(updateData) } });
  return updated;
}
```

```js
export async function deletePlan(planId) {
  const id = Number(planId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پلن نامعتبر است');

  const existing = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');

  // Soft delete: plans are referenced by historical payments/subscriptions.
  const updated = await prisma.plan.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { isActive: false },
  });

  await logEvent({ action: 'ADMIN_PLAN_DELETED', entity: 'Plan', entityId: id });
  return updated;
}
```

```js
export async function getRevenue({ from, to, groupBy = 'day', planId } = {}) {
  const now = new Date();
  const defaultFrom = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const start = from ? new Date(from) : defaultFrom;
  const end = to ? new Date(to) : now;

  if (start > end) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'from must be before or equal to to');

  const planFilter = planId ? Prisma.sql`AND "planId" = ${planId}` : Prisma.empty;

  const [totals, series] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.aggregate({
      where: {
        status: 'COMPLETED',
        createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end },
        ...(planId ? { planId } : {}),
      },
      _sum: { amountToman: true },
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
    prisma.$queryRaw`
      SELECT date_trunc(${groupBy}, "createdAt") AS bucket,
             SUM("amountToman")::int AS revenue,
             COUNT(*)::int AS count
      FROM "Payment"
      WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
        AND "createdAt" >= ${start}
        AND "createdAt" <= ${end}
        ${planFilter}
      GROUP BY bucket
      ORDER BY bucket ASC
    `,
  ]);

  return {
    range: { from: start, to: end, groupBy },
    totals: {
      revenueToman: totals._sum.amountToman ?? 0,
      payments: totals._count._all,
    },
    series: series.map((row) => ({
      bucket: row.bucket,
      revenueToman: Number(row.revenue),
      payments: Number(row.count),
    })),
  };
}
```

Also, `SUM("amountToman")::int` — if there are no rows, SUM returns NULL, but since we GROUP BY, there are no rows at all, so no issue.

Hmm, one issue: `COUNT(*)::int` returns int, but Prisma raw query returns bigint for COUNT. Casting to int makes it a number. Good.

```js
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { encrypt } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { toPublicPayment } from './payment.service.js';
import { toPublicSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

function parseId(value, label) {
  const id = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', `${label} نامعتبر است`);
  }
  return id;
}

function paginationMeta(page, limit, total) {
  return { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) };
}

async function safeLog(payload) {
  try {
    await logEvent(payload);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to write audit log:', error?.message);
```

```
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { encrypt } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { toPublicPayment } from './payment.service.js';
import { toPublicSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const REVENUE_GROUPS = new Set(['day', 'week', 'month']);
const PAYMENT_SORT_FIELDS = new Set(['createdAt', 'amountToman', 'status']);

function parseId(value, label) {
  const id = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', `${label} نامعتبر است`);
  }
  return id;
}

function paginationMeta(page, limit, total) {
  return { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) };
}

async function safeLog(payload) {
  try {
    await logEvent(payload);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to write audit log:', error?.message);
  }
}

export async function getStats() {
  const now = new Date();
  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * DAY_MS);

  const [
    totalUsers,
    activeUsers,
    newUsersLast30Days,
    totalPayments,
    completedPayments,
    pendingPayments,
    failedPayments,
    revenueAgg,
    revenueLast30Agg,
    activeSubscriptions,
    totalPlans,
    activePlans,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.user.count(),
    prisma.user.count({ where: { isActive: true } }),
    prisma.user.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } } }),
    prisma.payment.count(),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { status: 'COMPLETED' } }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { status: 'PENDING' } }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { status: 'FAILED' } }),
    prisma.payment.aggregate({
      where: { status: 'COMPLETED' },
      _sum: { amountToman: true },
    }),
    prisma.payment.aggregate({
      where: { status: 'COMPLETED', createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } },
      _sum: { amountToman: true },
    }),
    prisma.subscription.count({ where: { status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: now } } }),
    prisma.plan.count(),
    prisma.plan.count({ where: { isActive: true } }),
  ]);

  return {
    users: {
      total: totalUsers,
      active: activeUsers,
      newLast30Days: newUsersLast30Days,
    },
    payments: {
      total: totalPayments,
      completed: completedPayments,
      pending: pendingPayments,
      failed: failedPayments,
    },
    revenue: {
      totalToman: revenueAgg._sum.amountToman ?? 0,
      last30DaysToman: revenueLast30Agg._sum.amountToman ?? 0,
    },
    subscriptions: { active: activeSubscriptions },
    plans: { total: totalPlans, active: activePlans },
  };
}

export async function getRevenue({ from, to, groupBy = 'day', planId } = {}) {
  if (!REVENUE_GROUPS.has(groupBy)) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'groupBy must be one of day, week, month');
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const start = from ? new Date(from) : new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * DAY_MS);
  const end = to ? new Date(to) : now;

  if (Number.isNaN(start.getTime()) || Number.isNaN(end.getTime())) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'بازه زمانی نامعتبر است');
  }
  if (start > end) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'from must be before or equal to to');
  }

  const normalizedPlanId = planId !== undefined && planId !== null ? Number(planId) : undefined;
  const planFilter =
    normalizedPlanId !== undefined
      ? Prisma.sql`AND "planId" = ${normalizedPlanId}`
      : Prisma.empty;

  const [totals, series] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.aggregate({
      where: {
        status: 'COMPLETED',
        createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end },
        ...(normalizedPlanId !== undefined ? { planId: normalizedPlanId } : {}),
      },
      _sum: { amountToman: true },
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
    prisma.$queryRaw`
      SELECT date_trunc(${groupBy}::text, "createdAt") AS bucket,
             SUM("amountToman")::int AS revenue,
             COUNT(*)::int AS count
      FROM "Payment"
      WHERE "status" = 'COMPLETED'
        AND "createdAt" >= ${start}
        AND "createdAt" <= ${end}
        ${planFilter}
      GROUP BY bucket
      ORDER BY bucket ASC
    `,
  ]);

  return {
    range: { from: start, to: end, groupBy },
    totals: {
      revenueToman: totals._sum.amountToman ?? 0,
      payments: totals._count._all,
    },
    series: series.map((row) => ({
      bucket: row.bucket,
      revenueToman: Number(row.revenue),
      payments: Number(row.count),
    })),
  };
}

export async function listUsers({ page = 1, limit = 10, sortOrder = 'desc' } = {}) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [users, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.user.findMany({
      orderBy: { createdAt: sortOrder },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        fullName: true,
        role: true,
        isActive: true,
        lastLoginAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
      },
    }),
    prisma.user.count(),
  ]);

  return { data: users, meta: paginationMeta(page, limit, total) };
}

export async function getUserDetails(userId) {
  const id = parseId(userId, 'شناسه کاربر');

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    select: {
      id: true,
      email: true,
      fullName: true,
      role: true,
      isActive: true,
      avatarUrl: true,
      lastLoginAt: true,
      failedLoginCount: true,
      lockedUntil: true,
      createdAt: true,
      updatedAt: true,
    },
  });

  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const [subscription, payments, auditLogs] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.subscription.findFirst({
      where: { userId: id },
      orderBy: { endDate: 'desc' },
      include: { plan: true },
    }),
    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where: { userId: id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 20,
      include: { plan: true },
    }),
    prisma.auditLog.findMany({
      where: { userId: id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 20,
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    user,
    subscription: subscription ? toPublicSubscription(subscription) : null,
    recentPayments: payments.map(toPublicPayment),
    recentAuditLogs: auditLogs,
  };
}

export async function updateUser(userId, data = {}) {
  const id = parseId(userId, 'شناسه کاربر');

  const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const updateData = {};

  if (data.fullName !== undefined) {
    updateData.fullName = data.fullName;
  }

  if (data.email !== undefined && data.email !== existing.email) {
    const conflict = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
    if (conflict) throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این ایمیل قبلا ثبت شده است');
    updateData.email = data.email;
  }

  if (data.phone !== undefined) {
    updateData.phoneEncrypted = data.phone ? encrypt(data.phone) : null;
  }

  if (data.role !== undefined) {
    updateData.role = data.role;
  }

  if (data.isActive !== undefined) {
    updateData.isActive = data.isActive;
  }

  if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'هیچ فیلدی برای به‌روزرسانی ارسال نشده است');
  }

  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const user = await tx.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data: updateData,
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        fullName: true,
        role: true,
        isActive: true,
        avatarUrl: true,
        lastLoginAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
      },
    });

    // Deactivating a user must invalidate their active sessions.
    if (data.isActive === false) {
      await tx.refreshToken.updateMany({
        where: { userId: id, revokedAt: null },
        data: { revokedAt: new Date() },
      });
    }

    return user;
  });

  await safeLog({
    userId: id,
    action: 'ADMIN_USER_UPDATED',
    entity: 'User',
    entityId: id,
    details: { fields: Object.keys(updateData) },
  });

  return updated;
}

export async function listPayments(filters = {}) {
  const {
    page = 1,
    limit = 10,
    sortOrder = 'desc',
    sortBy = 'createdAt',
    status,
    userId,
    planId,
    from,
    to,
    minAmountToman,
    maxAmountToman,
  } = filters;

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  const sortField = PAYMENT_SORT_FIELDS.has(sortBy) ? sortBy : 'createdAt';

  const where = {};
  if (status) where.status = status;
  if (userId !== undefined) where.userId = Number(userId);
  if (planId !== undefined) where.planId = Number(planId);

  if (from || to) {
    where.createdAt = {};
    if (from) where.createdAt.gte = new Date(from);
    if (to) where.createdAt.lte = new Date(to);
  }

  if (minAmountToman !== undefined || maxAmountToman !== undefined) {
    where.amountToman = {};
    if (minAmountToman !== undefined) where.amountToman.gte = Number(minAmountToman);
    if (maxAmountToman !== undefined) where.amountToman.lte = Number(maxAmountToman);
  }

  const [payments, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { [sortField]: sortOrder },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      include: {
        plan: true,
        user: { select: { id: true, email: true, fullName: true } },
      },
    }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where }),
  ]);

  return {
    data: payments.map((payment) => ({
      ...toPublicPayment(payment),
      user: payment.user,
    })),
    meta: paginationMeta(page, limit, total),
  };
}

export async function getPaymentDetails(paymentId) {
  const id = parseId(paymentId, 'شناسه پرداخت');

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: {
      plan: true,
      user: { select: { id: true, email: true, fullName: true } },
      subscription: true,
    },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  return {
    ...toPublicPayment(payment),
    authority: payment.authority,
    user: payment.user,
    subscription: payment.subscription,
  };
}

export async function listAuditLogs({ page = 1, limit = 10, sortOrder = 'desc' } = {}) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [logs, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.auditLog.findMany({
      orderBy: { createdAt: sortOrder },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      include: {
        user: { select: { id: true, email: true, fullName: true } },
      },
    }),
    prisma.auditLog.count(),
  ]);

  return { data: logs, meta: paginationMeta(page, limit, total) };
}

export async function listPlans() {
  return prisma.plan.findMany({ orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } });
}

export async function createPlan(data = {}) {
  const name = String(data.name ?? '').trim();
  if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 120) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'نام پلن باید بین ۲ تا ۱۲۰ کاراکتر باشد');
  }

  const price = Number(data.price);
  if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const duration = Number(data.duration);
  if (!Number.isInteger(duration) || duration <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'مدت پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const description =
    data.description === undefined || data.description === null
      ? null
      : String(data.description).trim();

  const plan = await prisma.plan.create({
    data: {
      name,
      description,
      price,
      duration,
      isActive: data.isActive !== undefined ? Boolean(data.isActive) : true,
    },
  });

  await safeLog({
    action: 'ADMIN_PLAN_CREATED',
    entity: 'Plan',
    entityId: plan.id,
    details: { name: plan.name, price: plan.price, duration: plan.duration },
  });

  return plan;
}

export async function updatePlan(planId, data = {}) {
  const id = parseId(planId, 'شناسه پلن');

  const existing = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');

  const updateData = {};

  if (data.name !== undefined) {
    const name = String(data.name).trim();
    if (name.length < 2 || name.length > 120) {
      throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'نام پلن باید بین ۲ تا ۱۲۰ کاراکتر باشد');
    }
    updateData.name = name;
  }

  if (data.description !== undefined) {
    updateData.description =
      data.description === null ? null : String(data.description).trim();
  }

  if (data.price !== undefined) {
    const price = Number(data.price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) {
      throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
    }
    updateData.price = price;
  }

  if (data.duration !== undefined) {
    const duration = Number(data.duration);
    if (!Number.isInteger(duration) || duration <= 0) {
      throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'مدت پلن نامعتبر است');
    }
    updateData.duration = duration;
  }

  if (data.isActive !== undefined) {
    updateData.isActive = Boolean(data.isActive);
  }

  if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'هیچ فیلدی برای به‌روزرسانی ارسال نشده است');
  }

  const updated = await prisma.plan.update({ where: { id }, data: updateData });

  await safeLog({
    action: 'ADMIN_PLAN_UPDATED',
    entity: 'Plan',
    entityId: id,
    details: { fields: Object.keys(updateData) },
  });

  return updated;
}

export async function deletePlan(planId) {
  const id = parseId(planId, 'شناسه پلن');

  const existing = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');

  // Soft delete: plans are referenced by historical payments and subscriptions,
  // so a hard delete would break those records. Deactivating hides the plan
  // from the public listing while preserving history.
  const updated = await prisma.plan.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { isActive: false },
  });

  await safeLog({
    action: 'ADMIN_PLAN_DELETED',
    entity: 'Plan',
    entityId: id,
    details: { softDeleted: true },
  });

  return updated;
}

export default {
  getStats,
  getRevenue,
  listUsers,
  getUserDetails,
  updateUser,
  listPayments,
  getPaymentDetails,
  listAuditLogs,
  listPlans,
  createPlan,
  updatePlan,
  deletePlan,
};
```

```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';

export async function listActivePlans() {
  const plans = await prisma.plan.findMany({ where: { isActive: true }, orderBy: { price: 'asc' } });
  return plans.map(toPublicPlan);
}

export async function getPlanById(id) {
  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: Number(id) } });
  return plan ? toPublicPlan(plan) : null;
}

export function toPublicPlan(plan) {
  if (!plan) return null;
  const { id, name, description, price, duration, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt } = plan;
  return { id, name, description, price, duration, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt };
}
```

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CANCELLED
  EXPIRED
  PENDING
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  COMPLETED
  FAILED
}

model User {
  id               Int            @id @default(autoincrement())
  email            String         @unique
  passwordHash     String
  fullName         String?
  phoneEncrypted   String?
  avatarUrl        String?
  role             Role           @default(USER)
  isActive         Boolean        @default(true)
  failedLoginCount Int            @default(0)
  lockedUntil      DateTime?
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime       @updatedAt

  refreshTokens    RefreshToken[]
  subscriptions    Subscription[]
  payments         Payment[]
  auditLogs        AuditLog[]
  notifications    Notification[]
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  tokenHash String    @unique
  userId    Int
  expiresAt DateTime
  revokedAt DateTime?
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
}

model Plan {
  id          Int            @id @default(autoincrement())
  name        String
  description String?
  price       Float
  duration    Int            @default(30)
  isActive    Boolean        @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime       @updatedAt

  subscriptions Subscription[]
  payments      Payment[]
}

model Subscription {
  id        Int                @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int
  planId    Int
  status    SubscriptionStatus @default(PENDING)
  startDate DateTime
  endDate   DateTime
  createdAt DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime           @updatedAt
  user      User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan      Plan               @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  payments  Payment[]

  @@index([userId, status])
}

model Payment {
  id             Int           @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId         Int
  planId         Int
  subscriptionId Int?
  amountToman    Int
  durationDays   Int?
  status         PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  authority      String?       @unique
  refId          String?
  cardPanMasked  String?
  verifiedAt     DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime      @updatedAt
  user           User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan           Plan          @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  subscription   Subscription? @relation(fields: [subscriptionId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId, status])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int?
  action    String
  entity    String?
  entityId  Int?
  details   Json?
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([action])
}

model Notification {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int
  type      String
  title     String
  body      String
  readAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, readAt])
}
```

```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';

export async function listActivePlans() {
  const plans = await prisma.plan.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },
    orderBy: { price: 'asc' },
  });
  return plans.map(toPublicPlan);
}

export async function getPlanById(id) {
  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({
    where: { id },
  });
  return plan ? toPublicPlan(plan) : null;
}

export function toPublicPlan(plan) {
  if (!plan) return null;
  const { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt } = plan;
  return { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt };
}
```

```js
export async function getDashboard(userId) {
  const now = new Date();
  
  const subscription = await prisma.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: now } },
    include: { plan: true }
  });

  let daysRemaining = 0;
  if (subscription) {
    daysRemaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((subscription.endDate.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
  }

  const payments = await prisma.payment.findMany({
    where: { userId, status: 'COMPLETED' }
  });
  
  const totalPayments = payments.length;
  const totalSpentToman = payments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amountToman, 0);

  const unreadNotifications = await prisma.notification.count({
    where: { userId, readAt: null }
  });

  return {
    subscription: subscription ? {
      id: subscription.id,
      status: subscription.status,
      startDate: subscription.startDate,
      endDate: subscription.endDate,
      daysRemaining,
      plan: subscription.plan
    } : null,
    stats: {
      totalPayments,
      totalSpentToman,
      daysRemaining
    },
    unreadNotifications
  };
}
```

```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { encrypt, decrypt } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import { toPublicSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

export async function getMe(userId) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');
  
  let phone = null;
  if (user.phoneEncrypted) {
    try {
      phone = decrypt(user.phoneEncrypted);
    } catch (e) {
      phone = null;
    }
  }
  
  const { passwordHash, phoneEncrypted, ...publicUser } = user;
  return { ...publicUser, phone };
}

export async function updateMe(userId, data) {
  const updateData = {};
  if (data.fullName) updateData.fullName = data.fullName;
  if (data.phone) updateData.phoneEncrypted = encrypt(data.phone);

  const updatedUser = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: updateData
  });

  return getMe(updatedUser.id);
}

export async function saveAvatar(userId, file) {
  if (!file) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'فایلی ارسال نشده است');
  
  const oldUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  
  if (oldUser.avatarUrl) {
    const oldPath = path.join(process.cwd(), oldUser.avatarUrl);
    if (fs.existsSync(oldPath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(oldPath);
    }
  }

  const avatarUrl = `/uploads/${file.filename}`;
  
  const user = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: { avatarUrl }
  });

  return { avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl };
}

export async function getDashboard(userId) {
  const now = new Date();
  
  const subscription = await prisma.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: now } },
    include: { plan: true }
  });

  const payments = await prisma.payment.findMany({
    where: { userId, status: 'COMPLETED' }
  });
  
  const totalPayments = payments.length;
  const totalSpentToman = payments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amountToman, 0);

  const unreadNotifications = await prisma.notification.count({
    where: { userId, readAt: null }
  });

  const publicSubscription = subscription ? toPublicSubscription(subscription) : null;

  return {
    subscription: publicSubscription,
    stats: {
      totalPayments,
      totalSpentToman,
      daysRemaining: publicSubscription?.daysRemaining ?? 0
    },
    unreadNotifications
  };
}

export async function listPayments(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  
  const [payments, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      include: { plan: true }
    }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { userId } })
  ]);

  const data = payments.map(p => ({
    id: p.id,
    planId: p.planId,
    planName: p.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: p.amountToman,
    status: p.status,
    refId: p.refId,
    cardPanMasked: p.cardPanMasked,
    createdAt: p.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: p.verifiedAt
  }));

  return { data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function listNotifications(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  
  const [notifications, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit
    }),
    prisma.notification.count({ where: { userId } })
  ]);

  return { data: notifications, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function markNotificationRead(userId, notificationId) {
  const notification = await prisma.notification.findFirst({
    where: { id: notificationId, userId }
  });

  if (!notification) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'اعلان یافت نشد');
  if (notification.readAt) return notification;

  return prisma.notification.update({
    where: { id: notificationId },
    data: { readAt: new Date() }
  });
}
```

```js
export async function markNotificationRead(userId, notificationId) {
  const id = Number(notificationId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه اعلان نامعتبر است');
  }

  const notification = await prisma.notification.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId }
  });

  if (!notification) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'اعلان یافت نشد');
  if (notification.readAt) return notification;

  return prisma.notification.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { readAt: new Date() }
  });
}
```

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CANCELLED
  EXPIRED
  PENDING
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  COMPLETED
  FAILED
}

model User {
  id               Int            @id @default(autoincrement())
  email            String         @unique
  passwordHash     String
  fullName         String?
  phoneEncrypted   String?
  avatarUrl        String?
  role             Role           @default(USER)
  isActive         Boolean        @default(true)
  failedLoginCount Int            @default(0)
  lockedUntil      DateTime?
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime       @updatedAt

  refreshTokens RefreshToken[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  payments      Payment[]
  auditLogs     AuditLog[]
  notifications Notification[]
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  tokenHash String    @unique
  userId    Int
  expiresAt DateTime
  revokedAt DateTime?
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
}

model Plan {
  id          Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  name        String
  description String?
  price       Float
  duration    Int      @default(30)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  subscriptions Subscription[]
  payments      Payment[]
}

model Subscription {
  id        Int                @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int
  planId    Int
  status    SubscriptionStatus @default(PENDING)
  startDate DateTime
  endDate   DateTime
  createdAt DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime           @updatedAt
  user      User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan      Plan               @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  payments  Payment[]

  @@index([userId, status])
}

model Payment {
  id             Int           @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId         Int
  planId         Int
  subscriptionId Int?
  amountToman    Int
  durationDays   Int?
  status         PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  authority      String?       @unique
  refId          String?
  cardPanMasked  String?
  verifiedAt     DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime      @updatedAt
  user           User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan           Plan          @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  subscription   Subscription? @relation(fields: [subscriptionId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId, status])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int?
  action    String
  entity    String?
  entityId  Int?
  details   Json?
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([action])
}

model Notification {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int
  type      String
  title     String
  body      String
  readAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, readAt])
}
```

```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';

export async function listActivePlans() {
  const plans = await prisma.plan.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },
    orderBy: { price: 'asc' },
  });
  return plans.map(toPublicPlan);
}

export async function getPlanById(id) {
  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({
    where: { id },
  });
  return plan ? toPublicPlan(plan) : null;
}

export function toPublicPlan(plan) {
  if (!plan) return null;
  const { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt } = plan;
  return { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt };
}
```

```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';
import { sendExpiryReminderEmail, sendExpiredEmail } from './email.service.js';
import { AUDIT_ACTIONS, PAYMENT } from '../config/constants.js';

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS = 30;

function toDate(value) {
  return value ? new Date(value) : null;
}

function daysRemaining(endDate, now = new Date()) {
  if (!endDate) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((endDate.getTime() - now.getTime()) / DAY_MS));
}

export async function getActiveSubscription(userId) {
  return prisma.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: new Date() } },
    include: { plan: true },
    orderBy: { endDate: 'desc' },
  });
}

export function toPublicSubscription(sub) {
  if (!sub) return null;
  const endDate = toDate(sub.endDate);
  return {
    id: sub.id,
    status: sub.status,
    startsAt: sub.startDate,
    endsAt: endDate,
    daysRemaining: daysRemaining(endDate),
    plan: sub.plan ?? null,
  };
}

export async function cancelSubscription(userId) {
  const sub = await getActiveSubscription(userId);
  if (!sub) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'اشتراک فعالی یافت نشد');

  const updated = await prisma.subscription.update({
    where: { id: sub.id },
    data: { status: 'CANCELLED' },
  });

  await logEvent({
    userId,
    action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED,
    entity: 'Subscription',
    entityId: sub.id,
  });

  return toPublicSubscription({ ...updated, plan: sub.plan });
}

export async function activateSubscription(tx, { userId, planId, durationDays }) {
  const client = tx ?? prisma;

  const plan = await client.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
  if (!plan) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');

  const days = Number(durationDays) > 0 ? Number(durationDays) : DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS;
  const now = new Date();

  const currentSub = await client.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: now } },
    orderBy: { endDate: 'desc' },
  });

  if (currentSub) {
    const base = currentSub.endDate && currentSub.endDate > now ? currentSub.endDate : now;
    return client.subscription.update({
      where: { id: currentSub.id },
      data: { planId, endDate: new Date(base.getTime() + days * DAY_MS) },
    });
  }

  return client.subscription.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      planId,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      startDate: now,
      endDate: new Date(now.getTime() + days * DAY_MS),
    },
  });
}

export async function expireDueSubscriptions() {
  const now = new Date();

  const dueSubs = await prisma.subscription.findMany({
    where: { status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { lt: now } },
    include: { user: true },
  });

  let processed = 0;

  for (const sub of dueSubs) {
    await prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id: sub.id },
      data: { status: 'EXPIRED' },
    });

    await createNotification({
      userId: sub.userId,
      type: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED',
      title: 'اشتراک منقضی شد',
      body: 'اشتراک شما به پایان رسید. برای ادامه استفاده، لطفا پلن جدیدی خریداری کنید.',
    });

    await logEvent({
      userId: sub.userId,
      action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED,
      entity: 'Subscription',
      entityId: sub.id,
    });

    if (sub.user?.email) {
      await sendExpiredEmail(sub.user);
    }

    processed += 1;
  }

  return processed;
}

export async function sendExpiryReminders() {
  const now = new Date();
  const threshold = new Date(now.getTime() + PAYMENT.REMINDER_DAYS_BEFORE * DAY_MS);

  const subs = await prisma.subscription.findMany({
    where: {
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      endDate: { gt: now, lte: threshold },
    },
    include: { user: true, plan: true },
  });

  let processed = 0;

  for (const sub of subs) {
    await createNotification({
      userId: sub.userId,
      type: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRING',
      title: 'یادآوری انقضا',
      body: `اشتراک ${sub.plan?.name ?? ''} شما تا ${PAYMENT.REMINDER_DAYS_BEFORE} روز دیگر به پایان می‌رسد.`,
    });

    if (sub.user?.email) {
      await sendExpiryReminderEmail(sub.user);
    }

    processed += 1;
  }

  return processed;
}
```

```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { hashPassword, comparePassword } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import { signAccessToken, generateRefreshToken, hashToken } from '../utils/jwt.util.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';
import { AUDIT_ACTIONS, AUTH } from '../config/constants.js';

// A valid bcrypt hash used to equalize timing when the user does not exist.
const DUMMY_HASH = '$2b$10$N9qo8uLOickgx2ZMRZoMyeIjZAgcfl7p92ldGxad68LJZdL17lhWy';

export async function toPublicUser(dbUser) {
  if (!dbUser) return null;
  const { passwordHash, ...publicUser } = dbUser;
  return publicUser;
}

export async function register(data) {
  const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
  if (existing) throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این ایمیل قبلا ثبت شده است');
  
  const passwordHash = await hashPassword(data.password);
  const user = await prisma.user.create({
    data: {
      email: data.email,
      passwordHash,
      fullName: data.fullName,
      role: 'USER'
    }
  });
  
  await logEvent({ action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.REGISTER, entity: 'User', entityId: user.id });
  return toPublicUser(user);
}

export async function login(email, password, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
  
  // Timing safety: Compare against dummy hash if user doesn't exist
  const isValid = user
    ? await comparePassword(password, user.passwordHash)
    : await comparePassword(password, DUMMY_HASH);

  if (!user || !isValid) {
    if (user) {
      const failed = user.failedLoginCount + 1;
      const lockedUntil = failed >= AUTH.MAX_FAILED ? new Date(Date.now() + AUTH.LOCK_MINUTES * 60000) : null;
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: user.id },
        data: { failedLoginCount: failed, lockedUntil }
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_FAILED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است');
  }

  if (!user.isActive) throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'حساب کاربری غیرفعال است');
  if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date()) {
    throw new AppError(423, 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'حساب کاربری موقتا قفل شده است');
  }

  const { token: refreshToken, tokenHash, expiresAt } = generateRefreshToken();
  
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { failedLoginCount: 0, lockedUntil: null, lastLoginAt: new Date() }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.create({
      data: {
        userId: user.id,
        tokenHash,
        expiresAt,
        ip: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent']
      }
    })
  ]);

  const accessToken = signAccessToken({ sub: user.id, role: user.role });
  await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_SUCCESS, req });

  return { accessToken, refreshToken, user: toPublicUser(user) };
}

export async function refresh(oldRefreshToken, req) {
  if (!oldRefreshToken) throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'توکن یافت نشد');
  
  const tokenHash = hashToken(oldRefreshToken);
  const storedToken = await prisma.refreshToken.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash },
    include: { user: true }
  });

  if (!storedToken || storedToken.revokedAt || storedToken.expiresAt < new Date()) {
    if (storedToken && storedToken.revokedAt) {
      // Reuse detection: Revoke all tokens for this user
      await prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
        where: { userId: storedToken.userId, revokedAt: null },
        data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: storedToken.userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.TOKEN_REUSE_DETECTED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'توکن نامعتبر است');
  }

  // Rotate token
  const { token: newRefreshToken, tokenHash: newHash, expiresAt } = generateRefreshToken();
  
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.refreshToken.update({
      where: { id: storedToken.id },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.create({
      data: {
        userId: storedToken.userId,
        tokenHash: newHash,
        expiresAt,
        ip: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent']
      }
    })
  ]);

  const accessToken = signAccessToken({ sub: storedToken.user.id, role: storedToken.user.role });
  await logEvent({ userId: storedToken.userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.TOKEN_REFRESH, req });

  return { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefreshToken, user: toPublicUser(storedToken.user) };
}

export async function logout(refreshToken) {
  if (refreshToken) {
    await prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { tokenHash: hashToken(refreshToken) },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    });
  }
}

export async function changePassword(userId, currentPassword, newPassword, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const isValid = await comparePassword(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
  if (!isValid) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'رمز عبور فعلی اشتباه است');

  const newHash = await hashPassword(newPassword);
  
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { passwordHash: newHash }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId, revokedAt: null },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    })
  ]);

  await logEvent({ userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.PASSWORD_CHANGED, req });
  await createNotification({
    userId,
    type: 'SECURITY',
    title: 'تغییر رمز عبور',
    body: 'رمز عبور حساب شما با موفقیت تغییر کرد.'
  });
}
```
