import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { encrypt, decrypt } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import { toPublicSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

export async function getMe(userId) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');
  
  let phone = null;
  if (user.phoneEncrypted) {
    try {
      phone = decrypt(user.phoneEncrypted);
    } catch (e) {
      phone = null;
    }
  }
  
  const { passwordHash, phoneEncrypted, ...publicUser } = user;
  return { ...publicUser, phone };
}

export async function updateMe(userId, data) {
  const updateData = {};
  if (data.fullName) updateData.fullName = data.fullName;
  if (data.phone) updateData.phoneEncrypted = encrypt(data.phone);

  const updatedUser = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: updateData
  });

  return getMe(updatedUser.id);
}

export async function saveAvatar(userId, file) {
  if (!file) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'فایلی ارسال نشده است');
  
  const oldUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  
  // حذف آواتار قبلی اگر وجود داشت
  if (oldUser.avatarUrl) {
    const oldPath = path.join(process.cwd(), oldUser.avatarUrl);
    if (fs.existsSync(oldPath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(oldPath);
    }
  }

  const avatarUrl = `/uploads/${file.filename}`;
  
  const user = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: { avatarUrl }
  });

  return { avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl };
}

export async function getDashboard(userId) {
  const now = new Date();
  
  // ۱. اشتراک فعال
  const subscription = await prisma.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: now } },
    include: { plan: true }
  });

  // ۲. آمار پرداخت‌ها
  const payments = await prisma.payment.findMany({
    where: { userId, status: 'COMPLETED' }
  });
  
  const totalPayments = payments.length;
  const totalSpentToman = payments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amountToman, 0);

  // ۳. اعلان‌های خوانده نشده
  const unreadNotifications = await prisma.notification.count({
    where: { userId, readAt: null }
  });

  const publicSubscription = subscription ? toPublicSubscription(subscription) : null;

  return {
    subscription: publicSubscription,
    stats: {
      totalPayments,
      totalSpentToman,
      daysRemaining: publicSubscription?.daysRemaining ?? 0
    },
    unreadNotifications
  };
}

export async function listPayments(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  
  const [payments, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      include: { plan: true }
    }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { userId } })
  ]);

  const data = payments.map(p => ({
    id: p.id,
    planId: p.planId,
    planName: p.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: p.amountToman,
    status: p.status,
    refId: p.refId,
    cardPanMasked: p.cardPanMasked,
    createdAt: p.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: p.verifiedAt
  }));

  return { data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function listNotifications(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  
  const [notifications, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit
    }),
    prisma.notification.count({ where: { userId } })
  ]);

  return { data: notifications, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function markNotificationRead(userId, notificationId) {
  const id = Number(notificationId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه اعلان نامعتبر است');
  }

  const notification = await prisma.notification.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId }
  });

  if (!notification) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'اعلان یافت نشد');
  if (notification.readAt) return notification;

  return prisma.notification.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { readAt: new Date() }
  });
}

```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { hashPassword, comparePassword } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import { signAccessToken, generateRefreshToken, hashToken } from '../utils/jwt.util.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';
import { AUDIT_ACTIONS, AUTH } from '../config/constants.js';

// A valid bcrypt hash used to equalize timing when the user does not exist.
const DUMMY_HASH = '$2b$10$N9qo8uLOickgx2ZMRZoMyeIjZAgcfl7p92ldGxad68LJZdL17lhWy';

export async function toPublicUser(dbUser) {
  if (!dbUser) return null;
  const { passwordHash, ...publicUser } = dbUser;
  return publicUser;
}

export async function register(data) {
  const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
  if (existing) throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این ایمیل قبلا ثبت شده است');
  
  const passwordHash = await hashPassword(data.password);
  const user = await prisma.user.create({
    data: {
      email: data.email,
      passwordHash,
      fullName: data.fullName,
      role: 'USER'
    }
  });
  
  await logEvent({ action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.REGISTER, entity: 'User', entityId: user.id });
  return toPublicUser(user);
}

export async function login(email, password, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
  
  // Timing safety: Compare against dummy hash if user doesn't exist
  const isValid = user
    ? await comparePassword(password, user.passwordHash)
    : await comparePassword(password, DUMMY_HASH);

  if (!user || !isValid) {
    if (user) {
      const failed = user.failedLoginCount + 1;
      const lockedUntil = failed >= AUTH.MAX_FAILED ? new Date(Date.now() + AUTH.LOCK_MINUTES * 60000) : null;
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: user.id },
        data: { failedLoginCount: failed, lockedUntil }
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_FAILED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است');
  }

  if (!user.isActive) throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'حساب کاربری غیرفعال است');
  if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date()) {
    throw new AppError(423, 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'حساب کاربری موقتا قفل شده است');
  }

  const { token: refreshToken, tokenHash, expiresAt } = generateRefreshToken();
  
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { failedLoginCount: 0, lockedUntil: null, lastLoginAt: new Date() }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.create({
      data: {
        userId: user.id,
        tokenHash,
        expiresAt,
        ip: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent']
      }
    })
  ]);

  const accessToken = signAccessToken({ sub: user.id, role: user.role });
  await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_SUCCESS, req });

  return { accessToken, refreshToken, user: toPublicUser(user) };
}

export async function refresh(oldRefreshToken, req) {
  if (!oldRefreshToken) throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'توکن یافت نشد');
  
  const tokenHash = hashToken(oldRefreshToken);
  const storedToken = await prisma.refreshToken.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash },
    include: { user: true }
  });

  if (!storedToken || storedToken.revokedAt || storedToken.expiresAt < new Date()) {
    if (storedToken && storedToken.revokedAt) {
      // Reuse detection: Revoke all tokens for this user
      await prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
        where: { userId: storedToken.userId, revokedAt: null },
        data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: storedToken.userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.TOKEN_REUSE_DETECTED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'توکن نامعتبر است');
  }

  // Rotate token
  const { token: newRefreshToken, tokenHash: newHash, expiresAt } = generateRefreshToken();
  
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.refreshToken.update({
      where: { id: storedToken.id },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.create({
      data: {
        userId: storedToken.userId,
        tokenHash: newHash,
        expiresAt,
        ip: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent']
      }
    })
  ]);

  const accessToken = signAccessToken({ sub: storedToken.user.id, role: storedToken.user.role });
  await logEvent({ userId: storedToken.userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.TOKEN_REFRESH, req });

  return { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefreshToken, user: toPublicUser(storedToken.user) };
}

export async function logout(refreshToken) {
  if (refreshToken) {
    await prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { tokenHash: hashToken(refreshToken) },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    });
  }
}

export async function changePassword(userId, currentPassword, newPassword, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const isValid = await comparePassword(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
  if (!isValid) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'رمز عبور فعلی اشتباه است');

  const newHash = await hashPassword(newPassword);
  
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { passwordHash: newHash }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId, revokedAt: null },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    })
  ]);

  await logEvent({ userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.PASSWORD_CHANGED, req });
  await createNotification({
    userId,
    type: 'SECURITY',
    title: 'تغییر رمز عبور',
    body: 'رمز عبور حساب شما با موفقیت تغییر کرد.'
  });
}

  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const isValid = await comparePassword(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
  if (!isValid) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'رمز عبور فعلی اشتباه است');

  const newHash = await hashPassword(newPassword);
  
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { passwordHash: newHash }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId, revokedAt: null },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    })
  ]);

  await logEvent({ userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.PASSWORD_CHANGED, req });
  await createNotification({
    userId,
    type: 'SECURITY',
    title: 'تغییر رمز عبور',
    body: 'رمز عبور حساب شما با موفقیت تغییر کرد.'
  });
}
```

export async function listActivePlans() {
  const plans = await prisma.plan.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },
    orderBy: { price: 'asc' },
  });
  return plans.map(toPublicPlan);
}

export async function getPlanById(id) {
  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({
    where: { id },
  });
  return plan ? toPublicPlan(plan) : null;
}

export function toPublicPlan(plan) {
  if (!plan) return null;
  const { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt } = plan;
  return { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt };
}

Let me write:

```js
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import crypto from 'crypto';

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;
const IV_LENGTH = 16;

function getEncryptionKey() {
  const secret = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY;
  if (!secret) throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set');
  // Derive a fixed 32-byte key so any-length secret works with aes-256-gcm.
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest();
}

export function hashPassword(password) {
  return bcrypt.hash(password, SALT_ROUNDS);
}

export async function comparePassword(password, hash) {
  return bcrypt.compare(password, hash);
}

export function encrypt(text) {
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(IV_LENGTH);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', getEncryptionKey(), iv);
  let encrypted = cipher.update(text, 'utf8', 'hex');
  encrypted += cipher.final('hex');
  const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();
  return iv.toString('hex') + ':' + encrypted + ':' + tag.toString('hex');
}

export function decrypt(text) {
  const [iv, encrypted, tag] = text.split(':');
  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', getEncryptionKey(), Buffer.from(iv, 'hex'));
  decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(tag, 'hex'));
  let decrypted = decipher.update(encrypted, 'hex', 'utf8');
  decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
  return decrypted;
}
```

backend/prisma/seed.js
```
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

// Must match SALT_ROUNDS in backend/src/utils/hash.util.js
const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;

// Passwords can be overridden via env so real secrets never live in the repo.
const SEED_USERS = [
  {
    label: 'super admin',
    email: process.env.SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL || 'superadmin@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'SuperAdmin@123',
    // NOTE: schema.prisma has no SUPER_ADMIN role, so this is a regular ADMIN
    // distinguished only by email. Add SUPER_ADMIN to the Role enum to change this.
    role: 'ADMIN',
  },
  {
    label: 'admin',
    email: process.env.SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL || 'admin@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'Admin@123',
    role: 'ADMIN',
  },
  {
    label: 'user',
    email: process.env.SEED_USER_EMAIL || 'user@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_USER_PASSWORD || 'User@123',
    role: 'USER',
  },
];

// Plan has no `isActive` field in the current schema, so these are simply the
// three plans that will exist after seeding.
const SEED_PLANS = [
  { name: 'Basic', price: 99000 },
  { name: 'Pro', price: 199000 },
  { name: 'Enterprise', price: 499000 },
];

async function seedUsers() {
  for (const user of SEED_USERS) {
    const password = await bcrypt.hash(user.password, SALT_ROUNDS);

    const record = await prisma.user.upsert({
      where: { email: user.email },
      update: { password, role: user.role },
      create: { email: user.email, password, role: user.role },
    });

    console.log(`[seed] ${user.label} ready: ${record.email} (role=${record.role})`);
  }
}

async function seedPlans() {
  for (const plan of SEED_PLANS) {
    // Plan.name is not unique in the schema, so upsert-by-name is not possible.
    const existing = await prisma.plan.findFirst({ where: { name: plan.name } });

    if (existing) {
      await prisma.plan.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: { price: plan.price },
      });
      console.log(`[seed] plan updated: ${plan.name} (${plan.price})`);
    } else {
      await prisma.plan.create({ data: { name: plan.name, price: plan.price } });
      console.log(`[seed] plan created: ${plan.name} (${plan.price})`);
    }
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log('[seed] starting...');
  await seedUsers();
  await seedPlans();
  console.log('[seed] done.');
}

main()
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error('[seed] failed:', error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });
```

    email: process.env.SEED_USER_EMAIL || 'user@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_USER_PASSWORD || 'User@123',
    role: 'USER',
  },
];

// The current Plan model has no isActive field, so these are simply the three
// plans that will exist after seeding.
const SEED_PLANS = [
  { name: 'Basic', price: 99000 },
  { name: 'Pro', price: 199000 },
  { name: 'Enterprise', price: 499000 },
];

async function seedUsers() {
  for (const user of SEED_USERS) {
    const password = await bcrypt.hash(user.password, SALT_ROUNDS);

    const record = await prisma.user.upsert({
      where: { email: user.email },
      update: { password, role: user.role },
      create: { email: user.email, password, role: user.role },
    });

    console.log(`[seed] ${user.label} ready: ${record.email} (role=${record.role})`);
  }
}

async function seedPlans() {
  for (const plan of SEED_PLANS) {
    // Plan.name is not unique in the schema, so upsert-by-name is not possible.
    const existing = await prisma.plan.findFirst({ where: { name: plan.name } });

    if (existing) {
      await prisma.plan.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: { price: plan.price },
      });
      console.log(`[seed] plan updated: ${plan.name} (${plan.price})`);
    } else {
      await prisma.plan.create({ data: { name: plan.name, price: plan.price } });
      console.log(`[seed] plan created: ${plan.name} (${plan.price})`);
    }
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log('[seed] starting...');
  await seedUsers();
  await seedPlans();
  console.log('[seed] done.');
}

main()
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error('[seed] failed:', error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });
```

import crypto from 'crypto';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import cors from 'cors';
import hpp from 'hpp';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';

const CSRF_COOKIE = 'XSRF-TOKEN';
const CSRF_HEADER = 'x-csrf-token';
const SAFE_METHODS = new Set(['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']);

function getAllowedOrigins() {
  const raw = process.env.CORS_ORIGINS || process.env.APP_BASE_URL || '';
  return raw.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

export function applySecurity(app) {
  app.use(helmet());
  const allowed = getAllowedOrigins();
  app.use(cors({
    origin: allowed.length > 0 ? allowed : true,
    credentials: true,
  }));
  app.use(hpp());
  app.use(cookieParser());
}

export function issueCsrfToken(req, res, next) {
  const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  res.cookie(CSRF_COOKIE, token, {
    httpOnly: false, // must be readable by the SPA to echo in the header
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
  });
  return res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: { csrfToken: token } });
}

function timingSafeEqual(a, b) {
  const bufA = Buffer.from(String(a));
  const bufB = Buffer.from(String(b));
  if (bufA.length !== bufB.length) return false;
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(bufA, bufB);
}

export function csrfProtect(req, res, next) {
  if (SAFE_METHODS.has(req.method)) return next();
  const cookieToken = req.cookies?.[CSRF_COOKIE];
  const headerToken = req.headers[CSRF_HEADER] || req.body?.[CSRF_HEADER] || req.query?.[CSRF_HEADER];
  if (!cookieToken || !headerToken || !timingSafeEqual(cookieToken, headerToken)) {
    return res.status(403).json({ success: false, code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Invalid CSRF token' });
  }
  next();
}

I reviewed all three files. There are several real bugs, including one security hole. Here's what I found and what I'm changing.

## Problems found

**`auth.controller.js`**
1. **Authorization hole (critical).** `changePasswordHandler` uses `req.body.userId` instead of `req.user.id`. Any authenticated user can change *anyone's* password by passing their id. Must use the authenticated identity.
2. **Refresh/logout can never work.** `loginHandler` stores the refresh token in an `httpOnly` cookie, but `refreshHandler`/`logoutHandler` read `req.body.refreshToken`. The client cannot read an `httpOnly` cookie, so refresh always fails. They must read the cookie.
3. **`res.status(error.statusCode)` is always `undefined`.** `AppError` exposes `status`, not `statusCode`, so every error path calls `res.status(undefined)` and throws a secondary error. The global `errorHandler` already handles `AppError` correctly, so the `try/catch` blocks should go and handlers should use `asyncHandler`.
4. **`loginHandler` returns `{ token }` but the service returns `{ accessToken, ... }`** — so `token` is `undefined` in the response.
5. **`secure: true` on the cookie** breaks local dev over plain HTTP.

**`security.middleware.js`**
6. **`issueCsrfToken` calls `req.csrfToken()`, but `csurf` is never installed** in `applySecurity`, so that route throws. I'm replacing it with a self-contained double-submit implementation.
7. **The CSRF cookie is `httpOnly`**, so the SPA can't read it to echo in the `x-csrf-token` header that `csrfProtect` compares against — the check can never pass. It must be readable.
8. **`cors()` with no options** allows every origin; combined with cookie auth that's unsafe. It needs `credentials: true` and an explicit allowlist.
9. **String comparison for the CSRF token** — should be timing-safe.

**`rateLimit.middleware.js`**
10. Missing `standardHeaders`/`legacyHeaders` config (v7 warns) and no JSON body consistent with the app's response envelope.

import asyncHandler from '../utils/asyncHandler.util.js';
import { ok, created } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { register, login, refresh, logout, changePassword } from '../services/auth.service.js';

const REFRESH_COOKIE = 'refreshToken';
const REFRESH_COOKIE_MAX_AGE_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

// `secure` must be off in local dev, otherwise the browser silently drops the
// cookie over plain HTTP and refresh/logout appear broken.
function refreshCookieOptions() {
  return {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: REFRESH_COOKIE_MAX_AGE_MS,
  };
}

// The refresh token lives in an httpOnly cookie, so the browser cannot read it.
// Fall back to the body only for non-browser clients (mobile, server-to-server).
function readRefreshToken(req) {
  return req.cookies?.[REFRESH_COOKIE] || req.body?.refreshToken || null;
}

export const registerHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  const user = await register(req.body);
  return created(res, user, 'User registered successfully');
});

export const loginHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  const { accessToken, refreshToken, user } = await login(
    req.body.email,
    req.body.password,
    req
  );

  res.cookie(REFRESH_COOKIE, refreshToken, refreshCookieOptions());
  return ok(res, { token: accessToken, user }, 'Logged in successfully');
});

export const refreshHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  const { accessToken, refreshToken, user } = await refresh(readRefreshToken(req), req);

  res.cookie(REFRESH_COOKIE, refreshToken, refreshCookieOptions());
  return ok(res, { token: accessToken, user }, 'Token refreshed successfully');
});

export const logoutHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  await logout(readRefreshToken(req));

  const { maxAge, ...clearOptions } = refreshCookieOptions();
  res.clearCookie(REFRESH_COOKIE, clearOptions);
  return ok(res, null, 'Logged out successfully');
});

export const changePasswordHandler = asyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  // Always use the authenticated identity. Never trust a userId from the body:
  // doing so lets any logged-in user change another account's password.
  await changePassword(req.user.id, req.body.currentPassword, req.body.newPassword, req);
  return ok(res, null, 'Password changed successfully');
});
```

backend/src/middlewares/security.middleware.js

import crypto from 'crypto';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import cors from 'cors';
import hpp from 'hpp';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';

const CSRF_COOKIE = 'XSRF-TOKEN';
const CSRF_HEADER = 'x-csrf-token';
const SAFE_METHODS = new Set(['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']);

function getAllowedOrigins() {
  const raw = process.env.CORS_ORIGINS || process.env.APP_BASE_URL || '';
  return raw
    .split(',')
    .map((origin) => origin.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

export function applySecurity(app) {
  app.use(helmet());

  const allowedOrigins = getAllowedOrigins();
  app.use(
    cors({
      // Reflecting every origin while sending credentials is unsafe. Require an
      // explicit allowlist in production; fall back to reflect-all only in dev.
      origin:
        allowedOrigins.length > 0
          ? allowedOrigins
          : process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
            ? false
            : true,
      credentials: true,
    })
  );

  app.use(hpp());
  app.use(cookieParser());
}

// Double-submit CSRF: issue a random token in a JS-readable cookie. The SPA
// echoes it back in the X-CSRF-Token header, and csrfProtect compares the two.
// This replaces the previous req.csrfToken() call, which required `csurf` to be
// installed and would otherwise throw.
export function issueCsrfToken(req, res) {
  const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

  res.cookie(CSRF_COOKIE, token, {
    httpOnly: false, // must be readable by the SPA to echo in the header
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
  });

  return res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: { csrfToken: token } });
}

function timingSafeEqual(a, b) {
  const bufA = Buffer.from(String(a));
  const bufB = Buffer.from(String(b));
  if (bufA.length !== bufB.length) return false;
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(bufA, bufB);
}

export function csrfProtect(req, res, next) {
  if (SAFE_METHODS.has(req.method)) return next();

  const cookieToken = req.cookies?.[CSRF_COOKIE];
  const headerToken =
    req.headers[CSRF_HEADER] || req.body?.[CSRF_HEADER] || req.query?.[CSRF_HEADER];

  if (!cookieToken || !headerToken || !timingSafeEqual(cookieToken, headerToken)) {
    return res.status(403).json({
      success: false,
      code: 'FORBIDDEN',
      message: 'Invalid CSRF token',
    });
  }

  return next();
}
```

import rateLimit from 'express-rate-limit';

function jsonLimiter({ windowMs, max, message }) {
  return rateLimit({
    windowMs,
    max,
    standardHeaders: true,
    legacyHeaders: false,
    message: { success: false, code: 'RATE_LIMITED', message },
  });
}

const globalLimiter = jsonLimiter({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  max: 300, // limit each IP to 300 requests per windowMs
  message: 'Too many requests, please try again later',
});

const authLimiter = jsonLimiter({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  max: 10, // limit each IP to 10 requests per windowMs
  message: 'Too many authentication attempts, please try again later',
});

const paymentLimiter = jsonLimiter({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  max: 20, // limit each IP to 20 requests per windowMs
  message: 'Too many payment requests, please try again later',
});

export { globalLimiter, authLimiter, paymentLimiter };
```

import express from 'express';
import path from 'path';
import { applySecurity } from './middlewares/security.middleware.js';
import { globalLimiter } from './middlewares/rateLimit.middleware.js';
import { notFoundHandler, errorHandler } from './middlewares/errorHandler.middleware.js';
import routes from './routes/index.js';

const app = express();

// Trust the first proxy hop so req.ip and rate limiting see the real client IP
// when deployed behind nginx / a load balancer.
app.set('trust proxy', 1);

// Security headers, CORS, HPP, cookie parsing.
applySecurity(app);

// Body parsers. The JSON limit is generous enough for avatar metadata but
// small enough to reject abusive payloads; file uploads go through multer.
app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '1mb' }));

## Dependencies this file relies on

- `applySecurity` from `middlewares/security.middleware.js` — installs helmet, CORS, HPP, and `cookieParser`. `cookieParser` **must** run before any route that reads `req.cookies` (the CSRF and refresh-token middleware), which is why security is applied first.

- `notFoundHandler` / `errorHandler` from `middlewares/errorHandler.middleware.js`.

## Design decisions

- **`trust proxy` is set to `1`.** Without it, `req.ip` is the proxy's IP and the rate limiter buckets every client together. This assumes exactly one proxy hop (nginx / a load balancer); adjust if you have more.
- **Static `/uploads` is registered before the rate limiter.** Loading avatars shouldn't consume the API request budget. The trade-off is that static files are not rate limited — acceptable since they're cheap to serve.
- **`/api/health` is rate limited.** At 300 requests / 15 min, a single 5-second health checker (180 requests) fits comfortably. If you run multiple checkers, tell me and I'll exempt `/health` from the limiter.
- **Cron jobs are not started here.** `startCronJobs()` belongs in `server.js` (the entry point), not `app.js`, so that importing the app in tests doesn't spin up schedulers. `cron.service.js` already short-circuits on `NODE_ENV === 'test'`, but keeping it out of `app.js` is cleaner.

```js
import app from './app.js';
import prisma from './config/database.js';
import { startCronJobs } from './services/cron.service.js';
import logger from './utils/logger.util.js';

const port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;
const SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

const server = app.listen(port, () => {
  logger.info(`Server listening on port ${port}`);
  startCronJobs();
});

let isShuttingDown = false;

async function shutdown(signal) {
  if (isShuttingDown) return;
  isShuttingDown = true;

  logger.info(`Received ${signal}. Starting graceful shutdown...`);

  // Force exit if shutdown hangs (e.g. a stuck keep-alive connection).
  const forceExitTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    logger.error(`Graceful shutdown timed out after ${SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Forcing exit.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }, SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS);
  forceExitTimer.unref();

  try {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close((err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve()));
      // Node 18.2+: proactively close idle keep-alive connections so close()
      // can complete instead of waiting for them to time out.
      server.closeIdleConnections?.();
    });
    logger.info('HTTP server closed.');

    await prisma.$disconnect();
    logger.info('Database connection closed.');

    clearTimeout(forceExitTimer);

**What changed:**
- Captured the `http.Server` from `app.listen()` so it can be closed.
- Added `shutdown()` on `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT` that stops accepting connections, closes idle keep-alive sockets (Node 18.2+), disconnects Prisma, then exits.
- Added a 10s force-exit timer so a stuck connection can't hang the process forever.
- Guarded against re-entrant shutdown (multiple signals).
- Added `unhandledRejection` / `uncaughtException` handlers that log and shut down.
- Added a `server.on('error')` handler so bind failures (e.g. `EADDRINUSE`) are logged instead of crashing silently.

**One gap I can't close from this file:** `cron.service.js` exports `startCronJobs()` but no `stopCronJobs()`, so scheduled tasks aren't stopped during shutdown. Because `shutdown()` calls `process.exit()` explicitly, the process still exits cleanly — but a cron job could fire in the brief window between the signal and exit. If you want a fully clean shutdown, add `backend/src/services/cron.service.js` to the chat and I'll add a `stopCronJobs()` that calls `.stop()` on each task and wire it into `shutdown()`.

backend/src/server.js
```
import app from './app.js';
import prisma from './config/database.js';
import { startCronJobs } from './services/cron.service.js';
import logger from './utils/logger.util.js';

const port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;
const SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

const server = app.listen(port, () => {
  logger.info(`Server listening on port ${port}`);
  startCronJobs();
});

// Bind failures (e.g. EADDRINUSE) are emitted on the server, not thrown, so
// without this handler the process would crash with an unhandled 'error' event.
server.on('error', (error) => {
  logger.error('HTTP server error:', { message: error?.message, code: error?.code });
  shutdown('serverError');
});

let isShuttingDown = false;

async function shutdown(signal) {
  // Multiple signals (or a signal plus an uncaught exception) can arrive in
  // quick succession; only the first one should drive the shutdown.
  if (isShuttingDown) return;
  isShuttingDown = true;

  logger.info(`Received ${signal}. Starting graceful shutdown...`);

  // If a connection refuses to close, force the process down rather than
  // hanging forever. The timer is intentionally not unref'd: it must keep the
  // event loop alive long enough to fire if close() never completes.
  const forceExitTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    logger.error(`Graceful shutdown timed out after ${SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Forcing exit.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }, SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS);

  try {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close((err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve()));
      // Node 18.2+: proactively close idle keep-alive connections so close()
      // can complete instead of waiting for them to time out.
      server.closeIdleConnections?.();
    });
    logger.info('HTTP server closed.');

    await prisma.$disconnect();
    logger.info('Database connection closed.');

    clearTimeout(forceExitTimer);
    process.exit(0);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error during graceful shutdown:', {
      message: error?.message,
      stack: error?.stack,
    });
    clearTimeout(forceExitTimer);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));
process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));

process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
  logger.error('Unhandled promise rejection:', {
    message: reason?.message ?? String(reason),
    stack: reason?.stack,
  });
  shutdown('unhandledRejection');
});

process.on('uncaughtException', (error) => {
  logger.error('Uncaught exception:', {
    message: error?.message,
    stack: error?.stack,
  });
  shutdown('uncaughtException');
});
```

Note: `logger.error(msg, { ... })` is used instead of passing the raw `Error` because `logger.util.js` doesn't configure `format.errors({ stack: true })`, so a raw `Error` would serialize to `{}` in the JSON output.

export async function logEvent({ userId, action, entity, entityId, details, req }) {

        entity: entity ?? null,

        details: details ?? undefined,
        ip: req?.ip ?? null,
        userAgent: req?.headers?.['user-agent'] ?? null,

    });

    logger.error('Failed to write audit log:', { message: error?.message });

}

  const plans = await prisma.plan.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },

  });

  });

}

Now `auth.service.js` - fix lock expiry:
```js
export async function login(email, password, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });

  // Timing safety: Compare against dummy hash if user doesn't exist
  const isValid = user
    ? await comparePassword(password, user.passwordHash)
    : await comparePassword(password, DUMMY_HASH);

  if (!user || !isValid) {
    if (user) {
      // If the previous lock has expired, reset the counter so the user gets
      // a fresh set of attempts instead of being re-locked immediately.
      const lockExpired = user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil <= new Date();
      const baseCount = lockExpired ? 0 : user.failedLoginCount;
      const failed = baseCount + 1;
      const lockedUntil =
        failed >= AUTH.MAX_FAILED
          ? new Date(Date.now() + AUTH.LOCK_MINUTES * 60000)
          : null;
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: user.id },
        data: { failedLoginCount: failed, lockedUntil },
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_FAILED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است');
  }

  if (!user.isActive) throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'حساب کاربری غیرفعال است');
  if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date()) {
    throw new AppError(423, 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'حساب کاربری موقتا قفل شده است');
  }
  ...
}
```

Wait, there's still an issue. If the user is locked and provides the correct password, the code passes `!isValid` (since isValid is true), then hits the `lockedUntil` check and throws 423. Good.

But if the user is locked and provides wrong password, the code enters `!isValid`, increments `failedLoginCount` (which is already at MAX), and extends `lockedUntil`. That's fine for security but the error is 401 instead of 423. Minor UX issue. Let me move the lock check before the password check:

```js
export async function login(email, password, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });

  // Check lock first so a locked account always returns 423, regardless of
  // whether the supplied password is correct.
  if (user && user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date()) {
    throw new AppError(423, 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'حساب کاربری موقتا قفل شده است');
  }

  const isValid = user
    ? await comparePassword(password, user.passwordHash)
    : await comparePassword(password, DUMMY_HASH);

  if (!user || !isValid) {
    if (user) {
      const lockExpired = user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil <= new Date();
      const baseCount = lockExpired ? 0 : user.failedLoginCount;
      const failed = baseCount + 1;
      const lockedUntil =
        failed >= AUTH.MAX_FAILED
          ? new Date(Date.now() + AUTH.LOCK_MINUTES * 60000)
          : null;
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: user.id },
        data: { failedLoginCount: failed, lockedUntil },
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_FAILED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است');
  }

  if (!user.isActive) throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'حساب کاربری غیرفعال است');
  ...
}
```

Hmm, but this changes behavior: a locked user with correct password now gets 423 instead of being able to log in. That's the intended behavior (lock means no login). Good.

But wait, there's a subtle issue: if the lock has expired, `user.lockedUntil > new Date()` is false, so we proceed. Then if password is wrong, `lockExpired` is true, so `baseCount = 0`, `failed = 1`. Good.

If password is correct, we proceed to reset `failedLoginCount: 0, lockedUntil: null`. Good.

OK, this is better.

export async function listNotifications(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [notifications, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.notification.count({ where: { userId } }),
  ]);

  return { data: notifications, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

Now `hash.util.js` - validate encryption key:
```js
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import crypto from 'crypto';

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;
const IV_LENGTH = 16;
const ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm';

function getEncryptionKey() {
  const key = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set');
  }
  // Accept a 64-char hex string (32 bytes) or a 32-char raw string.
  if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(key)) {
    return Buffer.from(key, 'hex');
  }
  const buf = Buffer.from(key, 'utf8');
  if (buf.length !== 32) {
    throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY must be 32 bytes (64 hex chars or 32 raw chars)');
  }
  return buf;
}

export function hashPassword(password) {
  return bcrypt.hash(password, SALT_ROUNDS);
}

export async function comparePassword(password, hash) {
  return bcrypt.compare(password, hash);
}

export function encrypt(text) {
  const key = getEncryptionKey();
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(IV_LENGTH);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, iv);
  let encrypted = cipher.update(text, 'utf8', 'hex');
  encrypted += cipher.final('hex');
  const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();
  return iv.toString('hex') + ':' + encrypted + ':' + tag.toString('hex');
}

export function decrypt(text) {
  const key = getEncryptionKey();
  const [iv, encrypted, tag] = text.split(':');
  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, Buffer.from(iv, 'hex'));
  decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(tag, 'hex'));
  let decrypted = decipher.update(encrypted, 'hex', 'utf8');
  decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
  return decrypted;
}
```

export function authorizeRoles(...roles) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user || !req.user.role) {
      return next(new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'No user or role found'));
    }
    if (roles.includes(req.user.role)) {
      next();
    } else {
      next(new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Access denied'));
    }
  };
}
```

Hmm, actually, I just realized: `format.errors({ stack: true })` only transforms the `message` if it's an Error. For metadata, it doesn't. So `logger.error('msg', error)` would still have `error` as metadata, and `format.json()` would try to serialize it. `JSON.stringify(new Error('x'))` gives `{}`. So the error details are lost.

2. Add a custom format that transforms Error metadata

Let me add a custom format:

```js
const errorMetadataFormat = winston.format((info) => {
  for (const key of Object.keys(info)) {
    if (info[key] instanceof Error) {
      info[key] = { message: info[key].message, stack: info[key].stack };
    }
  }
  return info;
});
```

Then use it in the logger. This handles `logger.error('msg', error)`.

import winston from 'winston';

  for (const key of Object.keys(info)) {
    if (info[key] instanceof Error) {
      info[key] = { message: info[key].message, stack: info[key].stack };
    }

const logger = winston.createLogger({

          const metaStr = Object.keys(meta).length ? ` ${JSON.stringify(meta)}` : '';
          const stackStr = stack ? `\n${stack}` : '';
          return `${timestamp} [${level}]: ${message}${metaStr}${stackStr}`;
        })
      ),
    }),
  ],
});

if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
  logger.remove(logger.transports.Console);
  logger.add(
    new winston.transports.File({
      filename: 'error.log',
      level: 'error',

    })
  );
  logger.add(
    new winston.transports.File({

    })
  );
}

export default logger;

export function toPublicSubscription(sub) {
  if (!sub) return null;
  const endDate = toDate(sub.endDate);
  return {
    id: sub.id,
    status: sub.status,
    startsAt: sub.startDate,
    endsAt: endDate,
    daysRemaining: daysRemaining(endDate),
    plan: sub.plan ?? null,
  };
}
```

With schema fix, `endDate` is required. Good.

```js
export async function activateSubscription(tx, { userId, planId, durationDays }) {
  const client = tx ?? prisma;

  const plan = await client.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
  if (!plan) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');

  const days = Number(durationDays) > 0 ? Number(durationDays) : DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS;
  const now = new Date();

  const currentSub = await client.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: now } },
    orderBy: { endDate: 'desc' },
  });

  if (currentSub) {
    const base = currentSub.endDate && currentSub.endDate > now ? currentSub.endDate : now;
    return client.subscription.update({
      where: { id: currentSub.id },
      data: { planId, endDate: new Date(base.getTime() + days * DAY_MS) },
    });
  }

  return client.subscription.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      planId,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      startDate: now,
      endDate: new Date(now.getTime() + days * DAY_MS),
    },
  });
}
```

Good.

```js
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;

const SEED_USERS = [
  {
    label: 'super admin',
    email: process.env.SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL || 'superadmin@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'SuperAdmin@123',
    fullName: 'Super Admin',
    role: 'ADMIN',
  },
  {
    label: 'admin',
    email: process.env.SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL || 'admin@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'Admin@123',
    fullName: 'Admin',
    role: 'ADMIN',
  },
  {
    label: 'user',
    email: process.env.SEED_USER_EMAIL || 'user@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_USER_PASSWORD || 'User@123',
    fullName: 'Normal User',
    role: 'USER',
  },
];

const SEED_PLANS = [
  { name: 'Basic', description: 'Basic plan', price: 99000, duration: 30 },
  { name: 'Pro', description: 'Pro plan', price: 199000, duration: 30 },
  { name: 'Enterprise', description: 'Enterprise plan', price: 499000, duration: 30 },
];

async function seedUsers() {
  for (const user of SEED_USERS) {
    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(user.password, SALT_ROUNDS);

    const record = await prisma.user.upsert({
      where: { email: user.email },
      update: { passwordHash, role: user.role, fullName: user.fullName },
      create: {
        email: user.email,
        passwordHash,
        fullName: user.fullName,
        role: user.role,
      },
    });

    console.log(`[seed] ${user.label} ready: ${record.email} (role=${record.role})`);
  }
}

async function seedPlans() {
  for (const plan of SEED_PLANS) {
    const existing = await prisma.plan.findFirst({ where: { name: plan.name } });

    if (existing) {
      await prisma.plan.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: {
          description: plan.description,
          price: plan.price,
          duration: plan.duration,
          isActive: true,
        },
      });
      console.log(`[seed] plan updated: ${plan.name} (${plan.price})`);
    } else {
      await prisma.plan.create({
        data: {
          name: plan.name,
          description: plan.description,
          price: plan.price,
          duration: plan.duration,
          isActive: true,
        },
      });
      console.log(`[seed] plan created: ${plan.name} (${plan.price})`);
    }
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log('[seed] starting...');
  await seedUsers();
  await seedPlans();
  console.log('[seed] done.');
}

main()
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error('[seed] failed:', error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });
```

```js
export async function changePassword(userId, currentPassword, newPassword, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const isValid = await comparePassword(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
  if (!isValid) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'رمز عبور فعلی اشتباه است');

  const newHash = await hashPassword(newPassword);

  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { passwordHash: newHash }
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId, revokedAt: null },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() }
    })
  ]);

  await logEvent({ userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.PASSWORD_CHANGED, req });
  await createNotification({
    userId,
    type: 'SECURITY',
    title: 'تغییر رمز عبور',
    body: 'رمز عبور حساب شما با موفقیت تغییر کرد.'
  });
}
```

Good.

```js
const outcome = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  const claimed = await tx.payment.updateMany({
    where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
    data: {
      status: 'COMPLETED',
      refId: verification.refId,
      cardPanMasked: maskCardPan(verification.cardPan),
      verifiedAt: new Date(),
    },
  });

  if (claimed.count === 0) {
    const existing = await tx.payment.findUnique({
      where: { id: payment.id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });
    return { payment: existing, subscription: null, alreadyProcessed: true };
  }

  const subscription = await activateSubscription(tx, {
    userId: payment.userId,
    planId: payment.planId,
    durationDays: payment.durationDays,
  });

  const updated = await tx.payment.update({
    where: { id: payment.id },
    data: { subscriptionId: subscription.id },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  return { payment: updated, subscription, alreadyProcessed: false };
});
```

Good.

```js
export async function expirePendingPayments() {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);

  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { status: 'PENDING', createdAt: { lt: cutoff } },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count > 0) {
    logger.info(`Expired ${result.count} pending payment(s).`);
  }

  return result.count;
}
```

Good.

export async function saveAvatar(userId, file) {
  if (!file) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'فایلی ارسال نشده است');

  const oldUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });

  if (oldUser.avatarUrl) {
    const oldPath = path.join(process.cwd(), oldUser.avatarUrl);
    if (fs.existsSync(oldPath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(oldPath);
    }
  }

  const avatarUrl = `/uploads/${file.filename}`;

  const user = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: { avatarUrl }
  });

  return { avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl };
}

export async function getMe(userId) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  let phone = null;
  if (user.phoneEncrypted) {
    try {
      phone = decrypt(user.phoneEncrypted);
    } catch (e) {
      phone = null;
    }
  }

  const { passwordHash, phoneEncrypted, ...publicUser } = user;
  return { ...publicUser, phone };
}
```

    })
  );

}

```js
export function authenticate(req, res, next) {
  const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
  const token = authHeader && authHeader.split(' ')[1];

  if (!token) {
    return next(new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'No token provided'));
  }

  try {
    const decoded = verifyAccessToken(token);
    req.user = { id: decoded.sub, role: decoded.role };
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.name === 'TokenExpiredError') {
      return next(new AppError(401, 'TOKEN_EXPIRED', 'Access token expired'));
    }
    next(new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'Invalid token'));
  }
}
```

Good.

Let me also check `middlewares/role.middleware.js`:
```js
export function authorizeRoles(...roles) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user || !req.user.role) {
      return next(new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'No user or role found'));
    }

    if (roles.includes(req.user.role)) {
      next();
    } else {
      next(new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Access denied'));
    }
  };
}
```

export class AppError extends Error {
  constructor(status, code, message, details) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AppError';
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    if (details !== undefined) this.details = details;
    Error.captureStackTrace?.(this, this.constructor);
  }
}
```

### Schema rewrite

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CANCELLED
  PENDING
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  COMPLETED
  FAILED
}

model User {
  id               Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  email            String    @unique
  passwordHash     String
  fullName         String?
  phoneEncrypted   String?
  avatarUrl        String?
  role             Role      @default(USER)
  isActive         Boolean   @default(true)
  failedLoginCount Int       @default(0)
  lockedUntil      DateTime?
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt

  refreshTokens    RefreshToken[]
  subscriptions    Subscription[]
  payments         Payment[]
  auditLogs        AuditLog[]
  notifications    Notification[]
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  tokenHash String    @unique
  userId    Int
  expiresAt DateTime
  revokedAt DateTime?
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
}

model Plan {
  id          Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  name        String
  description String?
  price       Float
  duration    Int      @default(30)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  subscriptions Subscription[]
  payments      Payment[]
}

model Subscription {
  id        Int                @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int
  planId    Int
  status    SubscriptionStatus @default(PENDING)
  startDate DateTime
  endDate   DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime           @updatedAt
  user      User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan      Plan               @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  payments  Payment[]

  @@index([userId, status])
}

model Payment {
  id             Int           @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId         Int
  planId         Int
  subscriptionId Int?
  amountToman    Int
  durationDays   Int
  status         PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  authority      String?       @unique
  refId          String?
  cardPanMasked  String?
  verifiedAt     DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime      @updatedAt
  user           User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan           Plan          @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  subscription   Subscription? @relation(fields: [subscriptionId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int?
  action    String
  entity    String?
  entityId  Int?
  details   Json?
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Notification {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    Int
  type      String
  title     String
  body      String
  readAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, readAt])
}
```

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;

const SEED_USERS = [
  {
    label: 'super admin',
    email: process.env.SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL || 'superadmin@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'SuperAdmin@123',
    fullName: 'Super Admin',
    role: 'ADMIN',
  },
  {
    label: 'admin',
    email: process.env.SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL || 'admin@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'Admin@123',
    fullName: 'Admin',
    role: 'ADMIN',
  },
  {
    label: 'user',
    email: process.env.SEED_USER_EMAIL || 'user@example.com',
    password: process.env.SEED_USER_PASSWORD || 'User@123',
    fullName: 'Normal User',
    role: 'USER',
  },
];

const SEED_PLANS = [
  { name: 'Basic', description: 'Basic plan', price: 99000, duration: 30, isActive: true },
  { name: 'Pro', description: 'Pro plan', price: 199000, duration: 90, isActive: true },
  { name: 'Enterprise', description: 'Enterprise plan', price: 499000, duration: 365, isActive: true },
];

async function seedUsers() {
  for (const user of SEED_USERS) {
    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(user.password, SALT_ROUNDS);

    const record = await prisma.user.upsert({
      where: { email: user.email },
      update: { passwordHash, role: user.role, fullName: user.fullName },
      create: {
        email: user.email,
        passwordHash,
        fullName: user.fullName,
        role: user.role,
      },
    });

    console.log(`[seed] ${user.label} ready: ${record.email} (role=${record.role})`);
  }
}

async function seedPlans() {
  for (const plan of SEED_PLANS) {
    const existing = await prisma.plan.findFirst({ where: { name: plan.name } });

    if (existing) {
      await prisma.plan.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: {
          description: plan.description,
          price: plan.price,
          duration: plan.duration,
          isActive: plan.isActive,
        },
      });
      console.log(`[seed] plan updated: ${plan.name}`);
    } else {
      await prisma.plan.create({ data: plan });
      console.log(`[seed] plan created: ${plan.name}`);
    }
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log('[seed] starting...');
  await seedUsers();
  await seedPlans();
  console.log('[seed] done.');
}

main()
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error('[seed] failed:', error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

### hash.util.js fix

```js
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import crypto from 'crypto';

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;
const IV_LENGTH = 16;
const ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm';

function getEncryptionKey() {
  const key = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY;
  if (!key) {
    throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set');
  }
  // Accept either a 64-char hex string (32 bytes) or a 32-char raw string.
  if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(key)) {
    return Buffer.from(key, 'hex');
  }
  const buf = Buffer.from(key, 'utf8');
  if (buf.length !== 32) {
    throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY must be 32 bytes (64 hex chars or 32 raw chars)');
  }
  return buf;
}

export function hashPassword(password) {
  return bcrypt.hash(password, SALT_ROUNDS);
}

export async function comparePassword(password, hash) {
  return bcrypt.compare(password, hash);
}

export function encrypt(text) {
  const key = getEncryptionKey();
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(IV_LENGTH);
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, iv);
  let encrypted = cipher.update(text, 'utf8', 'hex');
  encrypted += cipher.final('hex');
  const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();
  return `${iv.toString('hex')}:${encrypted}:${tag.toString('hex')}`;
}

export function decrypt(text) {
  if (typeof text !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Invalid encrypted payload');
  }
  const parts = text.split(':');
  if (parts.length !== 3) {
    throw new Error('Invalid encrypted payload');
  }
  const [ivHex, encrypted, tagHex] = parts;
  const key = getEncryptionKey();
  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, Buffer.from(ivHex, 'hex'));
  decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(tagHex, 'hex'));
  let decrypted = decipher.update(encrypted, 'hex', 'utf8');
  decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
  return decrypted;
}
```

import prisma from '../config/database.js';

export function toPublicPlan(plan) {
  if (!plan) return null;
  const { id, name, description, price, duration, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt } = plan;
  return { id, name, description, price, duration, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt };
}

export async function listActivePlans() {
  const plans = await prisma.plan.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },
    orderBy: { price: 'asc' },
  });
  return plans.map(toPublicPlan);
}

export async function getPlanById(id) {
  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!plan || !plan.isActive) return null;
  return toPublicPlan(plan);
}

### errorHandler.middleware.js fix

```js
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';

export function notFoundHandler(req, res, next) {
  next(new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Resource not found'));
}

export function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  if (err instanceof AppError) {
    return res.status(err.status).json({
      success: false,
      code: err.code,
      message: err.message,
      meta: err.details,
    });
  }

  if (err instanceof ZodError) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
      message: 'Validation error',
      meta: err.issues,
    });
  }

  // Prisma errors: check by name/code to avoid importing a version-specific path.
  if (err?.name === 'PrismaClientKnownRequestError') {
    if (err.code === 'P2002') {
      return res.status(409).json({
        success: false,
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Duplicate entry',
      });
    }
    if (err.code === 'P2025') {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Record not found',
      });
    }
  }

  if (err instanceof jwt.TokenExpiredError) {
    return res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      code: 'TOKEN_EXPIRED',
      message: 'Token expired',
    });
  }

  if (err instanceof jwt.JsonWebTokenError) {
    return res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
      message: 'Invalid token',
    });
  }

  logger.error('Unhandled error:', {
    message: err?.message,
    stack: err?.stack,
    path: req.originalUrl,
    method: req.method,
  });

  res.status(500).json({
    success: false,
    code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
    message: 'Internal server error',
  });
}
```

### validation.middleware.js fix

```js
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';

function assign(target, key, value) {
  try {
    target[key] = value;
  } catch {
    Object.defineProperty(target, key, {
      value,
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      enumerable: true,
    });
  }
}

export function validate(schemas) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const { body, query, params } = req;

    try {
      if (body && schemas.body) {
        assign(req, 'body', schemas.body.parse(body));
      }

      if (query && schemas.query) {
        assign(req, 'query', schemas.query.parse(query));
      }

      if (params && schemas.params) {
        assign(req, 'params', schemas.params.parse(params));
      }

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ZodError) {
        return next(new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'Validation error', error.issues));
      }
      next(error);
    }
  };
}
```

### cron.service.js fix

```js
import cron from 'node-cron';
import { expireDueSubscriptions, sendExpiryReminders } from './subscription.service.js';
import { expirePendingPayments } from './payment.service.js';
import { env } from '../config/env.js';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';

let isSubscriptionJobRunning = false;
let isPaymentJobRunning = false;
const tasks = [];

export function startCronJobs() {
  if (env.NODE_ENV === 'test') {
    return;
  }

  logger.info('Cron jobs initialized.');

  const subscriptionTask = cron.schedule('0 * * * *', async () => {
    if (isSubscriptionJobRunning) return;
    isSubscriptionJobRunning = true;
    try {
      logger.info('Running hourly subscription checks...');
      await expireDueSubscriptions();
      await sendExpiryReminders();
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error in hourly subscription cron:', {
        message: error?.message,
        stack: error?.stack,
      });
    } finally {
      isSubscriptionJobRunning = false;
    }
  });

  const paymentTask = cron.schedule('*/5 * * * *', async () => {
    if (isPaymentJobRunning) return;
    isPaymentJobRunning = true;
    try {
      logger.info('Running 5-minute payment expiry checks...');
      await expirePendingPayments();
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error in payment expiry cron:', {
        message: error?.message,
        stack: error?.stack,
      });
    } finally {
      isPaymentJobRunning = false;
    }
  });

  tasks.push(subscriptionTask, paymentTask);
}

export function stopCronJobs() {
  for (const task of tasks) {
    task.stop();
  }
  tasks.length = 0;
  logger.info('Cron jobs stopped.');
}
```

### server.js fix

Add `stopCronJobs()` call in shutdown.

```js
import app from './app.js';
import prisma from './config/database.js';
import { startCronJobs, stopCronJobs } from './services/cron.service.js';
import logger from './utils/logger.util.js';

const port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;
const SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

const server = app.listen(port, () => {
  logger.info(`Server listening on port ${port}`);
  startCronJobs();
});

server.on('error', (error) => {
  logger.error('HTTP server error:', { message: error?.message, code: error?.code });
  shutdown('serverError');
});

let isShuttingDown = false;

async function shutdown(signal) {
  if (isShuttingDown) return;
  isShuttingDown = true;

  logger.info(`Received ${signal}. Starting graceful shutdown...`);

  const forceExitTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    logger.error(`Graceful shutdown timed out after ${SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Forcing exit.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }, SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS);

  try {
    stopCronJobs();

    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close((err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve()));
      server.closeIdleConnections?.();
    });
    logger.info('HTTP server closed.');

    await prisma.$disconnect();
    logger.info('Database connection closed.');

    clearTimeout(forceExitTimer);
    process.exit(0);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error during graceful shutdown:', {
      message: error?.message,
      stack: error?.stack,
    });
    clearTimeout(forceExitTimer);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));
process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));

process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
  logger.error('Unhandled promise rejection:', {
    message: reason?.message ?? String(reason),
    stack: reason?.stack,
  });
  shutdown('unhandledRejection');
});

process.on('uncaughtException', (error) => {
  logger.error('Uncaught exception:', {
    message: error?.message,
    stack: error?.stack,
  });
  shutdown('uncaughtException');
});
```

```js

...
const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', Buffer.from(ENCRYPTION_KEY), iv);
```

If `ENCRYPTION_KEY` is a 64-char hex string, `Buffer.from(ENCRYPTION_KEY)` creates a 64-byte buffer. `aes-256-gcm` needs 32 bytes. So this throws "Invalid key length". This is a real bug.

If `ENCRYPTION_KEY` is a 32-char string, `Buffer.from(ENCRYPTION_KEY)` creates a 32-byte buffer. Works.

So the fix is to handle both cases. My fix does that.

Also, `ENCRYPTION_KEY` is read at module load time. If it's not set, `Buffer.from(undefined)` throws. My fix reads it lazily and validates.

const [totals, series] = await Promise.all([
  prisma.payment.aggregate({
    where: {
      status: 'COMPLETED',
      createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end },
      ...(normalizedPlanId !== undefined ? { planId: normalizedPlanId } : {}),
    },
    _sum: { amountToman: true },
    _count: { _all: true },
  }),
  prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT date_trunc(${groupBy}::text, "createdAt") AS bucket,
           SUM("amountToman")::int AS revenue,
           COUNT(*)::int AS count
    FROM "Payment"
    WHERE "status" = 'COMPLETED'
      AND "createdAt" >= ${start}
      AND "createdAt" <= ${end}
      ${planFilter}
    GROUP BY bucket
    ORDER BY bucket ASC
  `,
]);
```

const id = parseId(userId, 'شناسه کاربر');

const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

const updateData = {};

if (data.fullName !== undefined) {
  updateData.fullName = data.fullName;
}

if (data.email !== undefined && data.email !== existing.email) {
  const conflict = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
  if (conflict) throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این ایمیل قبلا ثبت شده است');
  updateData.email = data.email;
}

if (data.phone !== undefined) {
  updateData.phoneEncrypted = data.phone ? encrypt(data.phone) : null;
}

if (data.role !== undefined) {
  updateData.role = data.role;
}

if (data.isActive !== undefined) {
  updateData.isActive = data.isActive;
}

if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
  throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'هیچ فیلدی برای به‌روزرسانی ارسال نشده است');
}

const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  const user = await tx.user.update({
    where: { id },
    data: updateData,
    select: {
      id: true,
      email: true,
      fullName: true,
      role: true,
      isActive: true,
      avatarUrl: true,
      lastLoginAt: true,
      createdAt: true,
      updatedAt: true,
    },
  });

  if (data.isActive === false) {
    await tx.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId: id, revokedAt: null },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() },
    });
  }

  return user;
});

Now, let me also check `admin.service.js` `getRevenue`:
```js
if (!REVENUE_GROUPS.has(groupBy)) {
  throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'groupBy must be one of day, week, month');
}

const now = new Date();
const start = from ? new Date(from) : new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * DAY_MS);
const end = to ? new Date(to) : now;

if (Number.isNaN(start.getTime()) || Number.isNaN(end.getTime())) {
  throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'بازه زمانی نامعتبر است');
}
if (start > end) {
  throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'from must be before or equal to to');
}

const normalizedPlanId = planId !== undefined && planId !== null ? Number(planId) : undefined;
const planFilter =
  normalizedPlanId !== undefined
    ? Prisma.sql`AND "planId" = ${normalizedPlanId}`
    : Prisma.empty;

const [totals, series] = await Promise.all([
  prisma.payment.aggregate({
    where: {
      status: 'COMPLETED',
      createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end },
      ...(normalizedPlanId !== undefined ? { planId: normalizedPlanId } : {}),
    },
    _sum: { amountToman: true },
    _count: { _all: true },
  }),
  prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT date_trunc(${groupBy}::text, "createdAt") AS bucket,
           SUM("amountToman")::int AS revenue,
           COUNT(*)::int AS count
    FROM "Payment"
    WHERE "status" = 'COMPLETED'
      AND "createdAt" >= ${start}
      AND "createdAt" <= ${end}
      ${planFilter}
    GROUP BY bucket
    ORDER BY bucket ASC
  `,
]);

return {
  range: { from: start, to: end, groupBy },
  totals: {
    revenueToman: totals._sum.amountToman ?? 0,
    payments: totals._count._all,
  },
  series: series.map((row) => ({
    bucket: row.bucket,
    revenueToman: Number(row.revenue),
    payments: Number(row.count),
  })),
};
```

const id = parseId(userId, 'شناسه کاربر');

const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

const updateData = {};

if (data.fullName !== undefined) {
  updateData.fullName = data.fullName;
}

if (data.email !== undefined && data.email !== existing.email) {
  const conflict = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
  if (conflict) throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این ایمیل قبلا ثبت شده است');
  updateData.email = data.email;
}

if (data.phone !== undefined) {
  updateData.phoneEncrypted = data.phone ? encrypt(data.phone) : null;
}

if (data.role !== undefined) {
  updateData.role = data.role;
}

if (data.isActive !== undefined) {
  updateData.isActive = data.isActive;
}

if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
  throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'هیچ فیلدی برای به‌روزرسانی ارسال نشده است');
}

const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  const user = await tx.user.update({
    where: { id },
    data: updateData,
    select: {
      id: true,
      email: true,
      fullName: true,
      role: true,
      isActive: true,
      avatarUrl: true,
      lastLoginAt: true,
      createdAt: true,
      updatedAt: true,
    },
  });

  if (data.isActive === false) {
    await tx.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId: id, revokedAt: null },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() },
    });
  }

  return user;
});

await safeLog({
  userId: id,
  action: 'ADMIN_USER_UPDATED',
  entity: 'User',
  entityId: id,
  details: { fields: Object.keys(updateData) },
});

return updated;
```

import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';

export function authorizeRoles(...roles) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user || !req.user.role) {
      return next(new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'No user or role found'));
    }

    if (roles.includes(req.user.role)) {
      next();
    } else {
      next(new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Access denied'));
    }
  };
}
```

2. `backend\src\middlewares\validation.middleware.js`:
```js
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';

// Express 5 exposes req.query as a getter-only property, so a plain assignment
// throws. Fall back to defineProperty when the property is not writable.
function assign(target, key, value) {
  try {
    target[key] = value;
  } catch {
    Object.defineProperty(target, key, {
      value,
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
      enumerable: true,
    });
  }
}

export function validate(schemas) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const { body, query, params } = req;

    try {
      if (body && schemas.body) {
        assign(req, 'body', schemas.body.parse(body));
      }

      if (query && schemas.query) {
        assign(req, 'query', schemas.query.parse(query));
      }

      if (params && schemas.params) {
        assign(req, 'params', schemas.params.parse(params));
      }

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ZodError) {
        // Keep the issues array structured: pass it as `details` so the error
        // handler can return it under `meta` instead of stringifying it.
        return next(new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'Validation error', error.issues));
      }
      next(error);
    }
  };
}
```

```js
import { prisma } from '../prisma.js';
import { toPublicPlan } from './utils.js';

export async function listActivePlans() {
  const plans = await prisma.plan.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },
  });
  return plans.map(toPublicPlan);
}

export async function getPlanById(id) {
  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({
    where: { id },
  });
  return plan ? toPublicPlan(plan) : null;
}

export function toPublicPlan(plan) {
  if (!plan) return null;
  const { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt } = plan;
  return { id, name, description, price, duration, createdAt, updatedAt };
}
```
